结论Conclusions

作者认为病理专用视觉模型在各设置中稳定领先,但头部模型差异小且依赖任务;模型规模和预训练数据量都不能单独解释性能差异;组合互补模型的集成能提升跨数据集和组织的稳健性。

The authors conclude that pathology vision models are consistently strong but top-model differences are small and task-dependent, that model and data scale do not by themselves explain performance, and that ensembling complementary models improves robustness.

局限Limitations

  • 作者:只做冻结特征 + linear probe,不代表微调后的上限。
  • 作者:TCGA / CPTAC 与预训练数据可能重叠,会抬高 in-domain 成绩。
  • 作者:规模分析用粗代理且是相关性的;slide 级 mean pooling 可能稀释局部信号。
  • 我们的理解:任务几乎都是肿瘤;肾脏以肾细胞癌形式出现(TCGA RCC 四分类、CPTAC 泛癌任务中的 CCRCC 切片,TCGA 泛癌任务的癌种未列出);没有非肿瘤疾病或异常检测任务,也不能说明哪个编码器做无监督异常检测最好。
  • Authors: frozen features + linear probe only, which does not represent the upper bound after fine-tuning.
  • Authors: TCGA / CPTAC may overlap with pretraining data, which would inflate in-domain scores.
  • Authors: the scaling analysis uses coarse proxies and is correlational; slide-level mean pooling may dilute local signals.
  • Our reading: almost all tasks are oncologic; kidney appears as renal cell carcinoma (TCGA 4-class RCC, CCRCC slides in CPTAC pan-cancer tasks; cancer types of the TCGA pan-cancer tasks are not listed); there are no non-tumour disease or anomaly-detection tasks, and the benchmark cannot show which encoder is best for unsupervised anomaly detection.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

我们的理解:这是评测层而非 detect → model → revert 的某一环。对伪影注入课题:头部病理编码器同一梯队、域外排名会变,所以肾脏 H&E 应同时提 2–3 套特征在目标肾脏数据上比较或集成;它的协议(冻结特征 + 简单头、in-domain 与域外分开、bootstrap + 两两检验 + FDR)可直接搬到肾脏异常检测 benchmark,只需把 linear probe 换成异常打分器;41 个任务里没有非肿瘤病变和异常检测,这正是伪影注入课题要补的空白。

Our reading: an evaluation layer for the artifact-injection topic. Top encoders are one tier and rankings shift out of domain, so extract 2–3 feature sets for kidney H&E and compare or ensemble on the target kidney data; reuse the protocol (frozen features, in- vs out-of-domain split, bootstrap + FDR) with anomaly scorers instead of a linear probe; the absence of non-tumour and anomaly tasks is the gap the artifact-injection topic fills.

Detecting anomalous anatomic regions in spatial transcriptomics with STANDS

Xu K, Lu Y, Hou S, et al. Detecting anomalous anatomic regions in spatial transcriptomics with STANDS. Nature Communications. 2024;15:8223.

doi:10.1038/s41467-024-52445-9 · source.pdf

全文已读full text readPDF
PDF 全文(pdftotext),含 Methods;Fig. 2、3 的数值从论文图中标注读出。补充材料未读。
Full PDF via pdftotext, including Methods; Fig. 2 and 3 values read from the figure labels. Supplementary material not read.
在正常参考切片上训练一个重建 GAN,把目标切片里重建得差的 spot 判为异常组织域,再跨样本对齐并聚成共享 / 样本特有的亚型,全程不需要异常 marker。
A reconstruction GAN trained on normal reference sections flags poorly reconstructed spots in target sections as anomalous tissue domains, then aligns samples and clusters anomalies into shared or sample-specific subtypes, without anomaly markers.

问题Problem

多个病人的空间转录组切片里,哪些区域被疾病改变了?哪些改变是所有病人共有、哪些只出现在个别病人?现有空间聚类方法不区分异常簇,或依赖专家给出的癌症 marker;唯一无 marker 的方法 Spatial-ID 需要带注释的单细胞参考、假阳性高,且因缺少跨样本对齐机制而难以处理多个目标样本。作者把这个任务称为 DDATD:检测、对齐、亚型三步。

Across several patients' spatial-transcriptomics sections, which regions has disease changed, and which changes are shared vs patient-specific? Spatial clustering does not separate anomalous clusters or needs expert cancer markers; the only marker-free method, Spatial-ID, needs an annotated single-cell reference, has many false positives and struggles with multiple target samples because it lacks cross-sample alignment. The authors call the task DDATD: detect, align, subtype.

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 预处理:去低质量基因,归一化 + log,用 SpatialDE 选 3000 个空间可变基因;每个 spot 截 112×112 像素 H&E 图块,ResNet-34 提 256 维特征;spot 坐标建 k=6 近邻图。
  2. C1 检测模型(GAN module I):表达用两层 GATv2 编码,图像特征用另一个 GAT 编码,两者经 Transformer 融合成 512 维;memory bank 用注意力从记忆队列重组嵌入(防 mode collapse);MLP / 反卷积解码器重建表达和图块。
  3. 训练目标:只在正常参考上训练,损失 = L1 重建 + 对抗损失(判别器带梯度惩罚)。
  4. 异常分数:目标 spot 的原始与重建在判别器 16 维输出上的余弦距离;对分数拟合带先验的两分量 GMM(MAP-EM),自动划出异常 spot。
  5. 无正常 ST 时:改用正常 scRNA-seq 训练,编码器换成 MLP,把 spot 当单细胞打分。
  6. C2 对齐:去掉异常后,module II 学非负映射矩阵 M,为每个目标 spot 找最像的参考 spot(kin 对);module III 学每个批次一个风格向量,相减后解码去重建 kin 参考 spot,从而把所有目标 spot 映射到参考空间。
  7. C3 亚型:对齐后的异常 spot 的嵌入与重建残差 x − x̂ 融合,用 DEC 迭代聚类,得到共享或样本特有的亚型。
  8. 评测:accuracy、F1、PR 曲线、新指标 SGD(比较预测与真值异常 spot 的 kNN 图结构);对齐用 iLISI、BatchKL、ASW、ARI;亚型用 Macro-F1、NMI、multi-SGD。
  1. Preprocess: drop low-quality genes, normalise + log, keep 3,000 spatially variable genes (SpatialDE); a 112×112-px H&E patch per spot embedded to 256-d by ResNet-34; a k=6 spatial neighbour graph.
  2. C1 detection model (GAN module I): a two-layer GATv2 encodes expression, another GAT encodes image features, a transformer fuses them into 512-d; a memory bank re-expresses the embedding from a memory queue by attention (against mode collapse); MLP / deconvolution decoders reconstruct expression and patch.
  3. Training objective: trained on the normal reference only; loss = L1 reconstruction + adversarial loss (gradient penalty on the discriminator).
  4. Anomaly score: cosine distance between real and reconstructed spot in the discriminator's 16-d output; a two-component GMM with priors (MAP-EM) on the scores marks anomalous spots automatically.
  5. No normal ST: train on normal scRNA-seq with an MLP encoder and score spots as cells.
  6. C2 alignment: after removing anomalies, module II learns a non-negative matrix M giving each target spot its most similar (kin) reference spot; module III learns one style vector per batch, subtracts it and decodes to the kin reference spot, mapping all target spots into reference space.
  7. C3 subtyping: fuse the embedding and residual x − x̂ of aligned anomalous spots and cluster iteratively with DEC into shared or sample-specific subtypes.
  8. Evaluation: accuracy, F1, PR curve and the new SGD metric (compares kNN-graph structure of predicted vs true anomalous spots); iLISI, BatchKL, ASW, ARI for alignment; Macro-F1, NMI, multi-SGD for subtypes.

术语Terms

空间转录组 spatial transcriptomics (ST)
在组织切片上逐点测全基因表达并保留坐标的技术。
spot
ST 的一个测量点;10x Visium 一个 spot 覆盖若干细胞。
10x Visium / Slide-seqV2 / Stereo-seq
三种 ST 平台,分辨率从多细胞 spot 到接近单细胞不等。
H&E
苏木精-伊红染色的常规病理切片图像。
异常组织域 ATD
与正常参考相比发生改变的连片组织区域,例如癌区。
原位癌 CIS / 浸润性癌 IC
尚局限在导管内的癌 / 已突破基底膜向周围浸润的癌。
批次效应 batch effect
不同切片、不同实验带来的非生物学差异。
三级淋巴结构 TLS
在慢性炎症或肿瘤中新形成的类淋巴结免疫细胞聚集。
spatial transcriptomics (ST)
Measures genome-wide expression spot by spot on a tissue section while keeping coordinates.
spot
One ST measurement location; a 10x Visium spot covers several cells.
10x Visium / Slide-seqV2 / Stereo-seq
Three ST platforms, ranging from multi-cell spots to near single-cell resolution.
H&E
Haematoxylin-and-eosin stained routine pathology section image.
ATD
Anomalous tissue domain: a contiguous region changed relative to normal reference, e.g. tumour.
cancer in situ CIS / invasive cancer IC
Cancer still confined within the duct / cancer that has breached the basement membrane and invades surrounding tissue.
batch effect
Non-biological differences introduced by different sections or experiments.
TLS
Tertiary lymphoid structure: lymph-node-like immune aggregates formed in chronic inflammation or tumours.

数据Data

26 组实验(Table 1),覆盖 10x Visium、Slide-seqV2、Stereo-seq,人和小鼠。参考:健康人乳腺 Visium、人肝尾状叶 Visium(正文未说明是否健康)、健康胰腺导管 scRNA-seq 等;目标:乳腺癌、胰腺导管腺癌、原发性硬化性胆管炎、肾细胞癌以及小鼠胚胎。肾细胞癌实验(GSE175540,Table 1 Exp 8)的参考本身是肾癌切片 C2,异常是 C3/C4 中 5 种 TLS 相关细胞域,不是正常肾 vs 疾病。评测用各数据集的真值组织域注释(正文未说明注释来源),部分实验中某个域被人为指定为异常。

26 experiments (Table 1) on 10x Visium, Slide-seqV2 and Stereo-seq, human and mouse. References include healthy breast Visium, liver caudate-lobe Visium (the main text does not say it is healthy) and healthy pancreatic-duct scRNA-seq; targets include breast cancer, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, primary sclerosing cholangitis, renal cell carcinoma and mouse embryo. In the RCC experiment (GSE175540, Table 1 Exp 8) the reference is itself an RCC section (C2) and the anomalies are five TLS-related cell domains in C3/C4, not normal kidney vs disease. Evaluation uses each dataset's ground-truth domain annotations (the main text does not say who made them); some domains are curated as anomalous.

主要结果Key results

单样本乳腺癌检测:SGD (0.78, 0.21),其余 5 个方法均 ≥ (1.31, 0.95);accuracy 与 F1 最高Fig. 2b
被误报的癌旁 spot(n=69)在 H&E 上看似正常,但 ACTB、TMSB10 表达介于正常(n=238)与已知癌(n=160)之间,作者解读为早期癌Fig. 2c–e
跨模态(scRNA-seq 参考 → 胰腺癌 Visium):accuracy、F1 最高,SGD 最低 (0.97, 0.53)Fig. 2f–g
两张乳腺癌切片联合检测:SGD (1.24, 1.04);SGD_degree 次优 Spatial-ID 1.57,SGD_cc 次优 CHETAH 1.42Fig. 3b

结论Conclusions

STANDS 在检测、对齐、亚型三项任务和多种平台上都优于各自的对照方法(亚型任务的对照是"检测 + 聚类"组合方法);正常参考可以用 scRNA-seq 代替;异常分数还能提示 H&E 上尚看不出的早期病变。

STANDS beats each task's baselines on detection, alignment and subtyping across platforms (for subtyping, composite detect-then-cluster pipelines); scRNA-seq can replace a normal ST reference; scores can hint at early lesions not visible on H&E.

局限Limitations

  • 作者:GAN 可换成扩散模型以更准地重建正常数据、减少假阳性。
  • 作者实验:对参考集规模和多样性敏感,参考里缺的正常组织类型会被误报。
  • 我们的理解:很多评测异常是把某个已知域从参考里剔除后人为指定的,更接近新类别检测,对渐进性疾病变化未直接检验。
  • 我们的理解:accuracy / F1 依赖阈值,阈值无关的结果只以 PR 曲线给出(无 AUPRC 数值),AUC 数值只在 Fig. 9 出现;3 个 GAN + DEC,调参成本高。
  • Authors: a diffusion model could replace the GAN for more accurate normal reconstruction and fewer false positives.
  • Authors' experiments: sensitive to reference size and diversity; normal tissue types missing from the reference get flagged.
  • Our reading: many benchmark anomalies are a known domain held out of the reference and designated anomalous, closer to novel-class detection; graded disease change is not tested directly.
  • Our reading: accuracy / F1 depend on the threshold; threshold-free results are shown only as PR curves (no AUPRC numbers) and AUC numbers appear only in Fig. 9; three GANs plus DEC are costly to tune.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

对应 detect 一环,是空间组学上"正常参考 → 重建 → 异常分数"的代表方法。我们的理解:可作为肾脏组学异常检测基准的重建类基线;论文含肾细胞癌 Visium 实验(GSE175540),但参考本身是癌切片、异常是 TLS 相关域,只能用来跑通流程,不是正常肾 vs 疾病的基准;Fig. 9 提醒基准必须报告参考集覆盖了哪些正常组织类型;"假阳性 = 早期病变"说明标记需要专家复核。重建残差能指出偏离的基因,但不是因果扰动预测,revert 还要另接扰动模型。

Covers the detect step with the reconstruction recipe on spatial omics. Our reading: a reconstruction baseline for the kidney-omics benchmark; the paper's renal-cell-carcinoma Visium experiment (GSE175540) uses a cancer section as reference and TLS-related domains as anomalies, so it can test the pipeline but is not a normal-kidney vs disease benchmark; Fig. 9 says a benchmark must report which normal tissue types the reference covers; 'false positive = early lesion' argues for expert review of flags. Residuals point to deviating genes but are not causal perturbation predictions, so revert needs a separate perturbation model.

Mapping and reprogramming human tissue microenvironments with MintFlow

Akbarnejad A, Steele L, Jafree DJ, et al. Mapping and reprogramming human tissue microenvironments with MintFlow. bioRxiv. 2025. doi:10.1101/2025.06.24.661094 (v3).

doi:10.1101/2025.06.24.661094 · 没有本地 PDF（见下方来源说明）No local PDF (see source note)

全文已读full text read无本地 PDFno local PDF
bioRxiv v3 全文 PDF(posted 2025-07-24,pdftotext,CC BY-NC-ND 4.0)+ Fig. 1 图片上印出的数值;补充材料未读。
Full bioRxiv v3 PDF (posted 2025-07-24, via pdftotext, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0) + numbers printed on Fig. 1; supplement not read.
用 flow matching 生成模型把空间转录组中每个细胞的表达拆成"本征"和"微环境诱导"两部分,并在电脑里删除或替换某类细胞,预测邻居表达如何变化。
A flow-matching generative model that splits each spatial-transcriptomics cell's expression into intrinsic and microenvironment-induced parts, and deletes or replaces cell types in silico to predict neighbours' response.

问题Problem

疾病中组织微环境会重编程局部细胞状态,但现有空间方法仍是描述性的,不能模拟组织扰动;已有的微环境建模方法要么分不开本征与微环境诱导变化,要么需事后解释嵌入、受线性假设限制、扩展性差,或需要基因-基因相互作用(如配体-受体)先验。

Microenvironments reprogram cell states in disease, but spatial methods remain descriptive and do not simulate tissue perturbation; existing models of microenvironment effects fail to separate intrinsic from induced variation, need post-hoc interpretation of embeddings, rely on linear assumptions, scale poorly, or need gene-gene interaction (e.g. ligand-receptor) priors.

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 输入:Xenium 等单细胞分辨率空间转录组的计数、坐标和细胞类型标签;按坐标建 k=5 近邻图,计算每个细胞邻域的细胞类型组成(MCC)。
  2. 隐变量:本征 z 和传出信号 s_out 的先验以细胞类型为条件;传入信号 s_in 是邻居 s_out 的平均,因此间接依赖 MCC。
  3. 生成:隐空间 flow matching + 神经 ODE 解码器,得到本征与微环境诱导表示,解码为 X_int 和 X_mic,两者相加等于观测计数。
  4. 可识别性(设计目标):模仿 iVAE,z 以细胞类型、s_in 以 MCC 为条件;最优传输目标在最优解处使分解唯一,但作者说明训练不保证达到最优解,细胞类型单一区域分离变弱;Wasserstein 分布匹配鼓励 z 和 x_int 不含邻居类型信息。
  5. 扩展:用随机组织方块作中心节点采样子图训练,可用于多张切片、数百万细胞。
  6. 下游:聚类微环境诱导嵌入得细胞状态(MCS)与微环境域,对微环境诱导表达做差异表达得基因程序(MGP),微环境评分标出信号热点。
  7. in silico 扰动:改细胞类型标签或删除一类细胞,按位置重建近邻图,比较扰动前后生成的表达。
  8. 评测:NicheCompass 模拟数据(带真值,EMD、MAE、MSE),真实数据上已知信号基因计数归入 X_mic 的比例,对比 SIMVI、MEFISTO 和随机基线。
  1. Input: counts, coordinates and cell-type labels from single-cell spatial transcriptomics such as Xenium; a k=5 neighbour graph gives each cell's neighbourhood cell-type composition (MCC).
  2. Latents: intrinsic z and outgoing s_out have cell-type-conditioned priors; incoming s_in is the average of the neighbours' s_out, so it is indirectly MCC-conditioned.
  3. Generation: latent flow matching with a neural-ODE decoder gives intrinsic and microenvironment-induced representations, decoded to X_int and X_mic, which sum to the observed counts.
  4. Identifiability (a design goal): iVAE-style, z is conditioned on cell type and s_in on MCC; an optimal-transport objective makes the split unique at its optimum, but the authors note training is not guaranteed to reach it and separation weakens in cell-type-homogeneous regions; Wasserstein distribution matching encourages z and x_int to carry no neighbour cell-type information.
  5. Scale: subgraphs sampled with random tissue crops as central nodes allow several sections with millions of cells.
  6. Downstream: clustering microenvironment-induced embeddings gives cell states (MCS) and domains, differential expression on microenvironment-induced expression gives gene programmes (MGPs), and the microenvironment score marks signalling hotspots.
  7. In silico perturbation: change cell-type labels or remove a cell type, rebuild the neighbour graph from positions, and compare generated expression before vs after.
  8. Evaluation: NicheCompass simulated data with ground truth (EMD, MAE, MSE), the share of known-signalling-gene counts assigned to X_mic on real data, against SIMVI, MEFISTO and random baselines.

术语Terms

Xenium
10x 的原位转录组平台,单细胞分辨率;本文用 5k-plex panel(约 5000 个基因)。
微环境 microenvironment
本文中指一个细胞在 k=5 近邻图中的邻居。
特应性皮炎 atopic dermatitis
以 2 型炎症为特征、T 细胞介导的慢性炎症性皮肤病(湿疹)。
透明细胞肾细胞癌 ccRCC
成人最常见的肾癌类型。
三级淋巴结构 TLS
在慢性炎症和肿瘤中形成的异位淋巴细胞聚集。
T 细胞耗竭 exhaustion
长期受刺激的 T 细胞功能下降,高表达 HAVCR2(TIM3)、LAG3、TOX 等标记。
ICB 免疫检查点阻断
用抗 PD-1 / PD-L1 等抗体解除 T 细胞抑制的治疗。
Treg 调节性 T 细胞
抑制免疫反应的 T 细胞亚群(本文标记 FOXP3、TIGIT、CTLA4)。
Xenium
10x's single-cell in-situ transcriptomics platform; this paper uses the 5k-plex panel (≈5,000 genes).
Microenvironment
Here, a cell's neighbours in the k=5 neighbour graph.
Atopic dermatitis
A T-cell-mediated chronic inflammatory skin disease with type-2 inflammation (eczema).
ccRCC
Clear-cell renal cell carcinoma, the most common adult kidney cancer.
TLS
Tertiary lymphoid structure: ectopic lymphoid aggregates that arise in chronic inflammation and cancer.
T-cell exhaustion
Loss of function in chronically stimulated T cells, with markers such as HAVCR2 (TIM3), LAG3, TOX.
ICB
Immune checkpoint blockade, e.g. anti-PD-1 / PD-L1 antibodies that release T-cell inhibition.
Treg
Regulatory T cells, which suppress immune responses (markers here FOXP3, TIGIT, CTLA4).

数据Data

特应性皮炎:8 名患者 10 张皮肤切片(5 皮损、5 非皮损;8 张新生成),Xenium 5k,QC 后 197,487 个细胞。黑色素瘤:10x 公开 5000-plex Xenium,98,749 个细胞。ccRCC:训练用 1 名患者(4 个区域:3 个肿瘤核心 + 肿瘤-正常交界),337,116 个细胞,24 种细胞类型;另 2 名患者只做验证。外部数据:4 名患者的皮炎 scRNA-seq、23 种疾病 / 6 种组织整合数据、10 名 dupilumab 治疗患者第 12 周样本、Li et al. 2022 ccRCC scRNA-seq(10 名患者、147,917 个细胞)、Bi et al. 2021 ICB 前后 ccRCC scRNA-seq、TCGA 606 例 ccRCC、Kaede 小鼠抗 PD-L1 模型。模拟数据:NicheCompass,10,000 个细胞、2,000 个基因。

Atopic dermatitis: 10 skin sections from 8 patients (5 lesional, 5 non-lesional; 8 newly generated), Xenium 5k, 197,487 cells after QC. Melanoma: public 10x 5000-plex Xenium, 98,749 cells. ccRCC: training on one patient (4 regions: 3 tumour cores + tumour–normal interface), 337,116 cells, 24 cell types; 2 more patients for validation only. External data: atopic-dermatitis scRNA-seq from 4 patients, a 23-disease / 6-tissue integrated dataset, week-12 samples from 10 dupilumab-treated patients, Li et al. 2022 ccRCC scRNA-seq (10 patients, 147,917 cells), Bi et al. 2021 pre/post-ICB ccRCC scRNA-seq, 606 TCGA ccRCC tumours, a Kaede mouse anti-PD-L1 model. Simulated: NicheCompass, 10,000 cells, 2,000 genes.

主要结果Key results

模拟基准 EMD(log、取负,越高越好;图中印出的数值):MintFlow 7.08,SIMVI −0.37,MEFISTO −4.36,random −3.79,random binary 2.45Fig. 1g
已知信号基因计数归入 X_mic 的比例:皮炎 0.247 vs SIMVI 0.053;黑色素瘤 0.62 vs 0.037;只有 MintFlow 能跑全部 10 张切片(0.66 vs 非信号基因 0.317)Fig. 1h
皮炎:微环境诱导的 CD8A+ ITGAE+ GZMB+ T 细胞簇(IL13、IL22、GZMB 升高),作者认为是表皮 2 型组织驻留记忆 T 细胞;T_DC 域为 T 细胞活化枢纽Fig. 2
模拟删除 Treg 提示炎症增强;把 Tconv 全替换为 Treg 后炎症通路不富集、DC 活化基因下调;dupilumab 应答者 Treg 通常从基线到第 12 周增加,2 名无应答者无显著变化Fig. 3

TCGA 606 例:TLS Border T 程序高表达对应更差生存(p = 0.0073),重编程状态高表达对应生存优势(p = 0.0034)Fig. 7g
Simulated EMD (log, negated, higher is better; numbers printed in the figure): MintFlow 7.08 vs SIMVI −0.37, MEFISTO −4.36, random −3.79, random binary 2.45Fig. 1g
Known-signalling-gene counts in X_mic: 0.247 vs SIMVI 0.053 (eczema), 0.62 vs 0.037 (melanoma); only MintFlow ran on all 10 sections (0.66 vs 0.317 for other genes)Fig. 1h
Atopic dermatitis: a microenvironment-induced CD8A+ ITGAE+ GZMB+ T-cell cluster (increased IL13, IL22, GZMB), read by the authors as epidermal type-2 tissue-resident memory T cells; the T_DC domain is a T-cell activation hubFig. 2

结论Conclusions

MintFlow 能在不依赖配体-受体等先验的情况下学习微环境如何重编程细胞状态,并通过 in silico 组织扰动生成可检验的假设,在特应性皮炎、黑色素瘤和肾癌中给出了致病性空间重编程的线索。

MintFlow learns how microenvironments reprogram cell states without ligand-receptor priors and generates testable hypotheses by in silico tissue perturbation, revealing pathogenic spatial reprogramming in atopic dermatitis, melanoma and kidney cancer.

局限Limitations

  • 作者:对低读数敏感,需要各切片基因 panel 一致。
  • 作者:受细胞分割误差影响;训练困难、需按数据集调超参;flow matching 训练计算量大;目前限于多张切片;方法不保证找到最优传输目标的最优解。
  • 我们的理解:ccRCC 训练和主要扰动分析只用 1 名患者(另 2 名只做验证);扰动是模型预测,只用外部签名、小鼠数据和生存关联间接验证。
  • 我们的理解:扰动对象是细胞组成而不是单个基因,依赖细胞类型标签质量;除模拟和黑色素瘤数据外,数据尚未公开。
  • Authors: sensitive to low read counts; needs consistent gene panels across sections.
  • Authors: affected by segmentation errors; hard to train with dataset-specific tuning; flow-matching training is compute-intensive; currently limited to multiple sections; the method is not guaranteed to find the optimum of the optimal-transport objective.
  • Our reading: ccRCC training and the main perturbation analyses use one patient (2 more only for validation); perturbations are model predictions, validated only indirectly by external signatures, mouse data and survival associations.
  • Our reading: perturbations act on cell composition, not single genes, and depend on cell-type label quality; apart from the simulated and melanoma data, the data are not yet public.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

主要对应 model → revert,且有肾癌应用。我们的理解:X_mic 和微环境评分不是异常检测,但可解释"异常区域是被哪类邻居改变的";删除 / 替换细胞类型是组织层面的 revert 预测,比单细胞药物扰动更贴近 virtual tissue;用于肾脏 Xenium 需要细胞类型标签和一致的 panel,预测仍需湿实验验证。

A model → revert paper with a kidney-cancer application. Our reading: X_mic does not detect anomalies but can explain which neighbours change an anomalous region; deleting / replacing cell types is a tissue-level revert prediction, closer to a virtual tissue than single-cell drug perturbation; kidney Xenium use needs cell-type labels and consistent panels, and predictions still need wet-lab tests.

Conditional Monge Gap enables generalizable single-cell perturbation modelling

Driessen A, Rajwade DA, Harsanyi B, Rapsomaniki M, Born J. Conditional Monge Gap enables generalizable single-cell perturbation modelling. Nature Machine Intelligence. 2026;8:984–996.

doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01242-8 · source.pdf

全文已读full text readPDF
Nature Machine Intelligence 正式版 PDF 全文(pdftotext,CC BY-NC-ND 4.0),含 Methods;Extended Data 表格为图片,数值未读。
Full published PDF via pdftotext (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0), including Methods; Extended Data tables are images and their numbers were not read.
用一个以药物 / 剂量为条件的神经最优传输模型,把未处理细胞的分布搬到处理后细胞的分布,并能只凭分子结构预测没见过的药物。
One neural optimal-transport model, conditioned on drug and dose, maps untreated-cell distributions to treated-cell distributions and predicts unseen drugs from molecular structure.

问题Problem

单细胞测量会破坏细胞,看不到同一个细胞处理前后,只能做分布层面的预测。已有神经 OT 方法每个条件训一个模型:新条件无法推断、训练成本高、不能在相似条件间共享信息。作者要一个以任意协变量为条件的全局 OT 模型,在见过和没见过的条件上都能用。

Single-cell measurement destroys cells, so prediction must be distribution-level. Existing neural OT trains one model per condition: no inference for new conditions, high cost, no sharing across similar conditions. The goal is one global, covariate-conditioned OT model for seen and unseen conditions.

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 输入:SciPlex 的 1,000 个高变基因先经普通自编码器压到 50 维潜空间(预训练后冻结);4i 直接用 48 维蛋白 + 形态特征。
  2. 条件:剂量取 log;药物用 RDKit(由 SMILES 得到的 194 维分子描述符)或 MoA(处理后细胞群两两 Wasserstein 距离做多维缩放得到的 10 维)嵌入;各经一层全连接后拼接成条件向量 c;组合用药用 DeepSets 平均。
  3. 模型:MLP(4×64,GELU)输入细胞与条件,输出位移 v,预测 = 细胞 + v。
  4. 目标:对所有条件求和的 Sinkhorn divergence(预测分布贴近真实处理后分布)+ λ·Monge gap(平均位移代价减熵 OT 代价,保证映射代价最优),λ = 0.01。
  5. 训练:每个 batch 256 个细胞、来自一个随机条件;AdamW,lr 1e-4;基于 OTT-JAX。
  6. 评测:见过的条件(IS)和没见过的条件(OOS:留出剂量、留出整种药、或 187 药 21 折各留 9 药);指标为特征均值 R²(top-50 差异基因)、Wasserstein、MMD;下界 identity,上界逐条件模型,对照方法 chemCPA。
  1. Input: SciPlex's 1,000 highly variable genes are encoded by a plain autoencoder into a 50-d latent (pretrained, then frozen); 4i uses its 48 protein + morphology features directly.
  2. Condition: log dose; the drug is embedded with RDKit (194 descriptors from SMILES) or MoA (10-d multidimensional scaling of pairwise Wasserstein distances between treated populations); each passes one dense layer and they are concatenated into c; combinations use DeepSets averaging.
  3. Model: an MLP (4×64, GELU) takes cell + condition and outputs a shift v; prediction = cell + v.
  4. Loss: Sinkhorn divergence summed over conditions (prediction close to the measured treated distribution) + λ·Monge gap (mean displacement cost minus entropic OT cost, for cost optimality), λ = 0.01.
  5. Training: batches of 256 cells from one random condition; AdamW, lr 1e-4; built on OTT-JAX.
  6. Evaluation: seen conditions (IS) and unseen ones (OOS: held-out dose, held-out drug, or 21 folds each holding out 9 of 187 drugs); metrics R² of feature means (top-50 DEGs), Wasserstein, MMD; identity as lower bound, per-condition models as upper bound, chemCPA as comparison.

术语Terms

数据Data

SciPlex3:A549、K562、MCF7 三个癌细胞系,187 种药 × 4 个剂量(10–10,000 nM)共 748 个条件,762,039 个细胞(对照 17,565)。4i:两株黑色素瘤细胞,40 种蛋白,97,748 个细胞(对照 10,995),35 种疗法、每种约 2,500 个细胞,48 个特征;条件实验用 27 种单药 + 6 种组合。

SciPlex3: A549, K562, MCF7 cancer cell lines, 187 drugs × 4 doses (10–10,000 nM), 748 conditions, 762,039 cells (17,565 controls). 4i: two melanoma lines, 40 proteins, 97,748 cells (10,995 controls), 35 therapies at ~2,500 cells each, 48 features; 27 single drugs + 6 combinations in conditional runs.

结论Conclusions

一个条件 OT 模型可以替代成组的逐条件模型,并从跨条件学习中获益;效应型嵌入最好,但条件数增多后结构型嵌入差距明显缩小,使得对新化合物做虚拟筛选成为可能。

A single conditional OT model can replace sets of per-condition models and benefits from cross-task learning; effect-based embeddings are best, but structure-based ones catch up with more conditions, opening virtual screening of new compounds.

局限Limitations

  • 作者:对新细胞类型、分布外条件、噪声和批次效应的泛化仍是挑战;高剂量或稀疏药物类别可能落在观测分布外。
  • 作者:组合用药的平均池化较为简单,可能抓不到复杂的协同或拮抗。
  • 作者:MoA 嵌入需要先测到该药的处理细胞;RDKit 在训练药物少时不稳定。
  • 我们的理解:全是体外癌细胞系药物处理,没有组织或空间信息;只学了"对照 → 处理"方向,反向"疾病 → 正常"未验证。
  • Authors: generalisation to new cell types, out-of-distribution conditions, noise and batch effects remains a challenge; high doses or sparse drug classes may lie outside the observed distribution.
  • Authors: average pooling for combinations is relatively simple and may miss complex synergy or antagonism.
  • Authors: MoA embeddings need measured treated cells for the drug; RDKit is unstable with few training drugs.
  • Our reading: in-vitro cancer cell lines only, no tissue or spatial data; only control → treated was learned, the disease → normal direction is untested.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

属于 model / revert 环节,不是异常检测。我们的理解:若把疾病细胞群当源、正常细胞群当目标,条件 OT 可以给"哪个扰动能把分布搬回正常"打分,其 Wasserstein / Sinkhorn 距离也可作为 revert 程度的分布级度量;但这需要合适的扰动数据,论文未做。对肾脏项目更现实的是在 snRNA 层面初筛候选扰动,再回空间数据核对。

A model / revert paper, not detection. Our reading: with diseased cells as source and normal cells as target, conditional OT could score which perturbation moves cells back to normal, and its OT distances could measure revert at the distribution level; this needs suitable perturbation data and was not tested. For kidney work, screen candidates at the snRNA level, then check on spatial data.

Wenckstern J, Jain E, Cheng Y, et al. AI-powered virtual tissues from spatial proteomics for clinical diagnostics and biomedical discovery. arXiv:2501.06039v2. 2025. Published as: The Virtual Tissues foundation model resolves spatial proteomics across scales. Nature. 2026;657:744–754.

The paper is now published in Nature ("The Virtual Tissues foundation model resolves spatial proteomics across scales", Nature 657:744–754, 2026, doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10884-y, CC BY 4.0; authors 3 and 4 swapped). Checked differences (v2 → Nature): combined response AUROC 0.817 → 0.823; gain over Wang et al. +4.53% → +5.14%; over immune-ratio baselines +23–30% → +26–32%; cell typing vs KRONOS +6.31% → +5.81%; Fig. 3c gains B/myeloid/NK/T 27.9/35.2/95.6/30.4% → 26.4/34.3/109.7/30.2%; IMC markers 147 → 146; reconstruction r 0.723±0.157 (mean of three schemes) → per scheme only (independent 0.800, marker 0.700, niche 0.668). The published version also extends to 32 cohorts (IMC, CODEX, Orion, MIBI), more than 5,100 patients and 239 markers, and adds zero-shot cell segmentation; METABRIC, ABMIL, retrieval and Meyer C-index numbers are unchanged.
空间蛋白质组学的基础模型:用蛋白质语言模型嵌入标记每个 marker 通道、用分解注意力的掩码自编码器预训练,一个骨干同时支持 marker 重建、细胞分型、组织级临床预测、病例检索和可迁移的生物标志物发现。
A spatial-proteomics foundation model: each marker channel is tagged with a protein-language-model embedding and a factorised-attention masked autoencoder is pretrained; one backbone supports reconstruction, cell typing, tissue-level prediction, case retrieval and transferable biomarker discovery.

问题Problem

多重成像每个研究的抗体 panel、流程和平台都不同,现有方法多为单一队列定制,知识无法跨队列迁移,发现的空间生物标志物也难以推广。现有编码器要么要求固定 panel,要么对高通道数扩展差,也很少利用蛋白本身的先验。

Every multiplexed-imaging study has its own panel, protocol and platform, and most methods are single-cohort, so knowledge and spatial biomarkers do not transfer. Existing encoders need fixed panels, scale poorly with channel count and ignore protein priors.

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 输入:IMC 图像随机裁 128×128 crop,每个 marker 通道切成 8×8 像素 patch(约一个细胞),得到 M×16×16 的 token 网格。
  2. marker 身份:每个 marker 的氨基酸序列经 ESM-2 得到 640 维嵌入,与 image token 各自线性投影后相加;每个位置再加一个可学习的 patch summary token。
  3. 编码器:16 个 Transformer block,交替使用 marker 注意力(同位置跨通道)和空间注意力(同通道跨位置),避免空间 × 通道的平方复杂度。
  4. 预训练:按通道独立掩码 60–100%,并随机丢弃 0–25% 通道;解码器按通道重建,MSE 损失;150 个 epoch,AdamW。
  5. 多尺度表征:patch summary token 与细胞分割 mask 卷积得 cell token,聚合得 niche / tissue token。
  6. 下游:细胞用线性探针或随机森林;组织用 ABMIL;病例检索用 niche token 间 Wasserstein 距离;生物标志物用 Leiden 多分辨率聚类 + 交叉验证 AUROC 挑簇,4 个签名组合成逻辑回归。
  7. 评测:14 个预训练数据集各自按病人随机 80/20 划分;对比 KRONOS、CA-MAE、ResNet;zero-shot 时整个队列不参与预训练。
  1. Input: random 128×128 crops of IMC images; each marker channel is cut into 8×8-pixel patches (about one cell), giving an M×16×16 token grid.
  2. Marker identity: each marker's amino-acid sequence is embedded by ESM-2 (640-d); marker and image tokens are linearly projected and summed; each position also gets a learnable patch summary token.
  3. Encoder: 16 transformer blocks alternating marker attention (same position, across channels) and spatial attention (same channel, across positions), avoiding the spatial × channel quadratic cost.
  4. Pretraining: independent per-channel masking of 60–100% plus random dropout of 0–25% of channels; channel-wise decoder, MSE loss; 150 epochs, AdamW.
  5. Multi-scale representations: patch summary tokens convolved with the cell segmentation mask give cell tokens; aggregation gives niche / tissue tokens.
  6. Downstream: linear probes or random forests on cells; ABMIL on tissues; case retrieval by Wasserstein distance between niche tokens; biomarkers by multi-resolution Leiden clustering + cross-validated AUROC ranking, with 4 signatures combined in a logistic regression.
  7. Evaluation: each of the 14 pretraining datasets is split randomly 80/20 by patient; baselines KRONOS, CA-MAE, ResNet; for zero-shot the whole cohort is left out of pretraining.

术语Terms

数据Data

15 个 IMC 数据集、8 个器官部位、147 种 marker;3,102 个病人、8,887 张图像、超过 259,000 个 256×256 crop、超过 1,450 万个分割细胞。14 个用于预训练(含肾脏样本的 IMMUcan panel 1);第 15 个(Meyer et al. 乳腺癌,163 个病人)在主分析后加入,用来检验签名迁移。关键下游队列:Cords 肺癌、METABRIC 乳腺癌、NeoTRIP 三阴乳腺癌(138 人,67 人 pCR)。

15 IMC datasets, 8 organ sites, 147 markers; 3,102 patients, 8,887 images, >259,000 crops of 256×256, >14.5 million segmented cells. Fourteen used for pretraining (IMMUcan panel 1 includes kidney); the 15th (Meyer et al. breast, 163 patients) was added after the main analysis to test signature transfer. Key downstream cohorts: Cords lung cancer, METABRIC breast cancer, NeoTRIP triple-negative breast cancer (138 patients, 67 with pCR).

结论Conclusions

一个 marker 感知、多尺度的基础模型可以把异质的多重成像数据统一成"虚拟组织",不需要任务特定微调就能做重建、注释、临床预测和跨队列生物标志物发现,且发现的签名能迁移到独立队列。

A marker-aware, multi-scale foundation model unifies heterogeneous multiplexed imaging into virtual tissues that support reconstruction, annotation, clinical prediction and cross-cohort biomarker discovery without task-specific fine-tuning, and the discovered signatures transfer to an independent cohort.

局限Limitations

  • 作者:与训练集生化关系弱的新 marker 的 zero-shot 会变差,虚拟扩充 panel 需要校准与不确定度。
  • 作者:稀有细胞状态难;生存分析未校正协变量,需前瞻验证;注意力只是部分解释。
  • 作者:需在更多疾病、组织处理流程和成像平台上验证;尚未与 H&E 等模态融合。
  • 我们的理解:下游全是肿瘤;签名在同一队列上挑选,AUROC 0.817 可能偏乐观;外部队列只验证了预后,没有验证应答。
  • Authors: zero-shot degrades for new markers weakly related to the training data; virtual panel augmentation needs calibration and uncertainty.
  • Authors: rare cell states are hard; survival analyses are not covariate-adjusted and need prospective validation; attention is only a partial explanation.
  • Authors: needs validation on more diseases, tissue-processing protocols and imaging platforms; not yet fused with H&E or other modalities.
  • Our reading: all downstream tasks are tumours; signatures were selected on the same cohort, so AUROC 0.817 may be optimistic; the external cohort tests prognosis, not response.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

属于 model(虚拟组织表征)环节,本身不做异常检测或扰动预测。我们的理解:它的掩码重建目标可以改造成"只在正常组织上拟合、用 niche 掩码重建误差当异常分数",其 cell / niche token 也可作为特征类异常检测的输入,适用于肾脏空间组学 / 多重成像数据;Fig. 5b 说明好的表征能放大治疗引起的分布位移。肾脏只出现在预训练语料里,用于肾活检前需要验证。

A model (virtual-tissue representation) paper; it does no anomaly detection or perturbation prediction. Our reading: its masked reconstruction could become an anomaly score if fitted on normal tissue only, with niche-masked reconstruction error as the score; its cell / niche tokens can feed feature-based detectors for kidney spatial-omics or multiplexed-imaging data; Fig. 5b suggests good representations amplify treatment-induced distribution shifts. Kidney appears only in pretraining, so kidney-biopsy use needs validation.

用瑞典一个地区全部 ECG 训练深度网络预测一年内心脏性猝死,再让生成模型沿“风险梯度”把低风险心跳变成高风险心跳,从中发现一个未被描述的 ECG 特征:aVL 导联 QRS 末端 R 波拖尾。
A deep network trained on all ECGs of a Swedish region predicts one-year sudden cardiac death; a generative model then morphs low-risk beats along the risk gradient, revealing an undescribed ECG feature — a slurred terminal R wave in lead aVL.

问题Problem

心脏性猝死可用植入式除颤器预防,但要先知道谁有风险。唯一常用指标 LVEF 漏掉大多数猝死者,又让许多低风险者植入从不放电的除颤器(Abstract)。ECG 便宜标准,但缺少链接可靠死因的大数据,深度模型学到的东西也难以变成人能理解的生物标志物(Introduction, Results)。

Sudden cardiac death is preventable with defibrillators if risk is known, but the only common predictor, LVEF, misses most deaths and flags many low-risk patients (Abstract). ECGs are cheap, yet large ECG datasets linked to causes of death were lacking, and what deep models learn rarely becomes an interpretable biomarker (Introduction, Results).

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 数据:瑞典 Halland 地区 2010–2016 年 441,614 份 ECG,链接死亡证明和病历;分析前先封存 40% 病人作 lockbox(Methods)。
  2. 标签:ECG 后一年内的心脏性猝死,按死亡证明定义(心脏或不明原因,院外或入院 24 小时内死亡);主分析限 80 岁以下(Methods)。
  3. 预测模型:64 层 ResNet(32 个残差块,128 个滤波器,卷积核 16),输入 10 秒 12 导联 ECG;多任务训练(猝死、猝死 vs 其他死因、LVEF ≤35%),再做 logit 校准(Methods)。
  4. 阈值:取 95% CI 下界超过除颤器试验对照组中位猝死率(4.9%/年)的最大组,即风险最高的 2.2%(Results, Fig. 1)。
  5. 外部验证:不微调,直接用于美国 251,858 份 ECG(结局 VF/VT)和台湾 257 例骤停 + 4,011 名对照(Results)。
  6. 生成式解释:把 ECG 切成单个心跳,训练 512 维潜空间的 VAE;沿预测风险对潜向量的梯度反复移动并解码,最多 2,000 步,得到同一病人的反事实高风险心跳(Methods)。
  7. 量化与检验:把看到的 aVL 波形变化写成一阶/二阶差分特征,控制常规 ECG 指标后在三个数据集中回归(Results, Fig. 5)。
  8. 除颤器分析:OLS 回归中“高风险 × 有除颤器”交互项估计少死多少;用 LVEF 组重现已知试验效果做合理性检验(Table 2)。
  1. Data: 441,614 ECGs from Region Halland, Sweden, 2010–2016, linked to death certificates and health records; 40% of patients sealed as a lockbox before any analysis (Methods).
  2. Label: SCD within one year of the ECG from death certificates (cardiac or ill-defined cause, death out of hospital or within 24 h of admission); main analyses in under-80s (Methods).
  3. Predictor: 64-layer ResNet (32 residual blocks, 128 filters, kernel 16) on 10-s 12-lead ECGs; multitask training (SCD, SCD vs other death, LVEF ≤35%), then logit calibration (Methods).
  4. Threshold: the largest group whose lower 95% CI exceeds the median control-arm SCD rate in defibrillator trials (4.9%/yr), i.e. the riskiest 2.2% (Results, Fig. 1).
  5. External validation without fine-tuning: 251,858 US ECGs (outcome VF/VT) and 257 Taiwanese arrests + 4,011 controls (Results).
  6. Generative explanation: ECGs are cut into single beats and a VAE with a 512-d latent space is trained; the latent is moved repeatedly along the gradient of predicted risk and decoded, up to 2,000 steps, giving counterfactual high-risk beats of the same patient (Methods).
  7. Quantify and test: the aVL change is coded as first/second-difference features and regressed in all three datasets, controlling for standard ECG measures (Results, Fig. 5).
  8. Defibrillator analysis: in an OLS regression, the high-risk × defibrillator interaction estimates how many fewer die; reproducing the known trial effect in the LVEF group serves as a face-validity check (Table 2).

术语Terms

心脏性猝死 SCD
心脏原因导致的突然死亡;本文按死亡证明定义(心脏或不明原因,院外或入院 24 小时内死亡)。
植入式除颤器 ICD
植入体内的装置,能在心律失常致命前检测并终止它。
LVEF
左室射血分数,由心脏超声测量;本文以 ≤35% 为降低,是目前唯一广泛使用的猝死预测指标。
VF/VT
心室颤动 / 室性心动过速,本文所说的心脏性猝死的直接机制。
12 导联 ECG / aVL
背景知识(非本文内容):心电图从 12 个方向记录心脏电活动,aVL 是其中一个导联。本文指出 aVL 正极最靠近心底部。
QRS 波 / R 波
背景知识(非本文内容):QRS 波群代表心室去极化,R 波是其中的正向波。
晚期钆增强 LGE
心脏 MRI 上的造影剂摄取差异,作者称最常与心肌纤维化相关。
Sudden cardiac death (SCD)
Sudden death from cardiac causes; defined here from death certificates (cardiac or ill-defined cause, out of hospital or within 24 h of admission).
Implanted defibrillator (ICD)
An implanted device that can detect and terminate arrhythmias before they kill.
LVEF
Left ventricular ejection fraction from cardiac ultrasound; ≤35% counts as reduced here; the only predictor of SCD in wide use.
VF/VT
Ventricular fibrillation / tachycardia, the mechanism of sudden cardiac death as the paper uses it.
12-lead ECG / aVL
Background, not from the paper: the ECG records cardiac electrical activity from 12 views, and aVL is one lead. The paper notes that aVL's positive electrode sits closest to the base of the heart.
QRS complex / R wave
Background, not from the paper: the QRS complex reflects ventricular depolarisation; the R wave is its positive deflection.
Late gadolinium enhancement (LGE)
Differences in contrast uptake on cardiac MRI, which the authors say are most often associated with myocardial fibrosis.

数据Data

瑞典 441,614 份 ECG、187,677 名患者(Reporting Summary);训练用 60% 病人的 262,554 份 ECG,lockbox 主分析 119,541 份 ECG / 35,885 名 80 岁以下患者(Results, Table 1)。外部:美国 Sharp HealthCare 251,858 份 ECG / 139,613 名患者,不同厂家设备;台湾台大医院 257 例骤停 + 4,011 名对照(Methods)。

Sweden: 441,614 ECGs from 187,677 patients (Reporting Summary); training on 262,554 ECGs from 60% of patients; lockbox main analysis 119,541 ECGs / 35,885 under-80 patients (Results, Table 1). External: USA 251,858 ECGs / 139,613 patients on a different manufacturer's system; Taiwan 257 arrests + 4,011 controls (Methods).

主要结果Key results

lockbox AUC 0.872(0.843–0.899);AHA/ACC 风险评分 0.697,SEER 0.655Results
高风险 2.2% 组年猝死率 7.0%,LVEF 降低组(1.9%)为 4.6%Abstract, Fig. 1
高风险组只有 13.9% 已知 LVEF 降低(86.1% 为新发现的高风险者)Fig. 3
美国 VF/VT zero-shot AUC 0.822;最高 2.2% 组 VF/VT 发生率 29.1%,基线 3.8%Results, Fig. 2b
台湾心律失常性骤停 AUC 0.767,非心律失常性“安慰剂” AUC 0.582(P<0.001)Results
有除颤器的高风险者比预期少死 54.4%(观察性);LVEF 组 67.5%,与试验 50–88% 一致Table 2
新特征:aVL 中 R 波末端拖尾取代尖锐 S 波;量化后在瑞典、美国显著,台湾不显著Fig. 4–5, Results
单导联模型 AUC 接近 12 导联;风险最高 10% 患者 MRI 上弥漫细微 LGE 更常见Results
Lockbox AUC 0.872 (0.843–0.899) vs AHA/ACC score 0.697 and SEER 0.655Results
High-risk 2.2%: 7.0% annual SCD vs 4.6% for reduced LVEF (1.9%)Abstract, Fig. 1
Only 13.9% of the high-risk group had known reduced LVEF (86.1% newly identified)Fig. 3
USA zero-shot VF/VT AUC 0.822; 29.1% VF/VT in the riskiest 2.2% vs 3.8% base rateResults, Fig. 2b
Taiwan arrhythmic-arrest AUC 0.767; non-arrhythmic placebo AUC 0.582 (P<0.001)Results
Defibrillator holders at high risk died 54.4% less than expected (observational); LVEF group 67.5%, matching trials (50–88%)Table 2
New feature: slurred terminal R wave in aVL instead of a sharp S wave; significant in Sweden and USA, not in TaiwanFigs. 4–5, Results
Single-lead models reach AUCs near the 12-lead model; riskiest 10% show more diffuse subtle LGE on MRIResults

结论Conclusions

作者认为深度学习在三大洲数据中找到了被医生忽视、可能从除颤器获益的新高风险患者;生成模型揭示的波形特征与弥漫性心肌纤维化的假设相符,为研究猝死机制提供了新途径,但需要随机试验(Results, Clinical implications)。

The authors conclude that deep learning finds overlooked high-risk patients across three continents who could benefit from defibrillators, and that the generatively revealed feature is consistent with diffuse myocardial fibrosis, opening a new route to study sudden death; a randomised trial is needed (Results, Clinical implications).

局限Limitations

  • 作者:除颤器获益来自观察性数据,可能有未测混杂;需随机试验(Results)。
  • 作者:死亡证明可能误分类;三个数据集设计与结局定义不同;台湾为病例对照,不能算 PPV(Results)。
  • 作者:生成与形变结果来自最初 30%/30% 数据而非 lockbox,用于产生假设;纤维化机制是推测(Methods, Results)。
  • 作者利益:两位作者是美国数据来源 Dandelion Health 的联合创始人(Competing interests)。
  • 我们的理解:形变只从 56 个心跳出发;作者称变化在中位心跳和真实心跳中普遍存在(补充材料 V.E,未读);量化特征在台湾不显著。
  • 论文内部不一致:美国患者数正文为 139,613,Reporting Summary 为 151,015。
  • Authors: defibrillator benefit is observational and may be confounded (Results).
  • Authors: death certificates can misclassify; datasets differ in design and outcomes; no PPV for the case–control Taiwan data (Results).
  • Authors: generative results come from the initial 30%/30% data, not the lockbox; the fibrosis mechanism is speculative (Methods, Results).
  • Authors' interests: two authors co-founded Dandelion Health, the US data source (Competing interests).
  • Our reading: morphing starts from 56 beats; the authors report the changes are general across median and actual beats (Supp. V.E, not read); the coded feature is not significant in Taiwan.
  • Inconsistency in the paper: US patients 139,613 in the text vs 151,015 in the Reporting Summary.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

我们的理解:这不是无监督异常检测,但示范了 detect 之后最难的一步——把“模型觉得异常”变成可命名、可量化、可在外部数据检验的特征。对伪影注入课题,可在 H&E 或单细胞表达的生成模型潜空间里沿异常分梯度做反事实形变,让病理专家判断变化是病变还是伪影;lockbox 封存测试集和“安慰剂”结局(检验异常分是否被已知伪影推高)也可直接写进 KidneyAnomalyBench。

Our reading: not unsupervised anomaly detection, but a model of the hardest step after detection — turning "the model finds this abnormal" into a named, measurable feature tested on external data. For the artifact-injection topic: score-gradient counterfactual morphing in the latent space of a generative model of H&E or single-cell expression, judged by pathologists as lesion or artifact; plus a sealed lockbox and placebo outcomes (does the anomaly score rise for known artifacts?) for KidneyAnomalyBench.

An artificial intelligence model to detect abnormal ejection fraction from non-contrast chest computed tomography: the CT–LVEF study

Raikhelkar J, Bai Z, Beecy AN, et al. An artificial intelligence model to detect abnormal ejection fraction from non-contrast chest computed tomography: the CT–LVEF study. European Heart Journal - Digital Health. 2026;7(6):ztag088.

doi:10.1093/ehjdh/ztag088 · 没有本地 PDF（见下方来源说明）No local PDF (see source note)

全文已读full text read无本地 PDFno local PDF
PMC 全文(PMC13322390,CC BY)
PMC full text (PMC13322390, CC BY)
用 3D vision transformer 从为其他原因拍的常规非门控、非增强胸部 CT 判断射血分数是否 <50%,开发医院 AUROC 0.786、外部医院 0.762。
A 3D vision transformer flags ejection fraction <50% from routine non-gated, non-contrast chest CTs taken for other reasons: AUROC 0.786 at the development site, 0.762 externally.

问题Problem

许多早期收缩性心衰患者没有症状、未被诊断,错过能减缓进展的药物治疗(Introduction)。EF 通常要靠超声心动图等专门检查(Discussion);胸部 CT 很常见,已有 AI 研究用 CT 预测心血管风险,但从非门控、非增强胸部 CT 计算 EF 此前没有人做过(Introduction, Discussion)。作者想知道能否从这些“顺带”的 CT 中筛出 EF 降低的患者。

Many patients with early systolic heart failure are asymptomatic and undiagnosed, missing therapy that slows progression (Introduction). EF usually needs echocardiography (Discussion); chest CT is common and AI on CT has been used for cardiovascular risk, but computing EF from non-gated, non-contrast chest CT has not been explored (Introduction, Discussion). Can these incidental CTs screen for reduced EF?

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 配对:在 Columbia(CU)和 Weill Cornell(WCM)找出 CT 前后 6 个月内做过超声的成人,得到 19,410 名患者的 34,058 对 CT–超声(Methods)。
  2. 标签:超声报告中的 LVEF,<50% 为阳性(Methods)。
  3. 预处理:换算 HU,窗 [−1000, 1000],OTSU 聚焦人体,重采样到 2 mm 各向同性,裁剪/补零到 164×164×164(Methods)。
  4. 模型:GenerateCT 的 CT-ViT 编码器(4 个轴位空间注意力 block + 4 个沿切片的注意力 block)输出 512 维特征,全连接头输出低 EF 概率(Methods)。
  5. 训练:二元交叉熵,AdamW,学习率 1e-5,batch 8,20 epoch;5 个随机种子(Methods)。
  6. 划分:CU 按病人分训练/验证/测试;WCM 全部作外部验证;两中心另有时间上更晚的独立测试集(Methods, Results)。
  7. 评估:AUROC、F1、校准、亚组、决策曲线;与两位胸部放射科医生盲法比较;Grad-CAM 可解释性;在无超声的 633 个 CT 上做筛查演示(Methods, Results)。
  1. Pairing: adults at Columbia (CU) and Weill Cornell (WCM) with an echo within 6 months of the CT, giving 34,058 CT–echo pairs from 19,410 patients (Methods).
  2. Label: LVEF from the echo report, <50% positive (Methods).
  3. Preprocessing: convert to HU, window [−1000, 1000], OTSU to focus on the body, resample to 2 mm isotropic, crop/zero-pad to 164×164×164 (Methods).
  4. Model: the GenerateCT CT-ViT encoder (4 axial spatial-attention blocks + 4 slice-wise attention blocks) outputs a 512-d feature; a fully connected head outputs P(low EF) (Methods).
  5. Training: binary cross-entropy, AdamW, lr 1e-5, batch 8, 20 epochs; 5 random seeds (Methods).
  6. Splits: CU split by patient into train/validation/test; all of WCM as external validation; both sites also have temporally later independent test sets (Methods, Results).
  7. Evaluation: AUROC, F1, calibration, subgroups, decision curves; blinded comparison with two thoracic radiologists; Grad-CAM interpretability; screening demo on 633 CTs without echo (Methods, Results).

术语Terms

射血分数 EF / LVEF
每次心跳左心室泵出的血占心室血量的百分比;<50% 视为收缩功能降低。
HFrEF / HFmrEF
射血分数降低 / 中间范围(mid-range)的心衰;作者指出这两类有可减少住院和死亡的指南导向治疗(Introduction)。
非门控 CT
扫描不与心跳同步(Introduction 的术语)。背景知识(非本文内容):心脏因此是模糊的“平均”图像,通常不用于测心功能。
非增强 CT
背景知识(非本文内容):不注射造影剂,血管与心腔对比度低。
超声心动图
心脏超声,测 EF 的常规检查。
Hounsfield 单位 HU
CT 灰度的物理单位;本文用 [−1000, 1000] HU 窗去掉空气(<−1000 HU)和骨(>1000 HU)(Methods)。背景知识(非本文内容):水为 0 HU。
Ejection fraction EF / LVEF
Percentage of the left ventricle's blood pumped out with each beat; <50% is treated as reduced systolic function.
HFrEF / HFmrEF
Heart failure with reduced / mid-range EF; the paper notes guideline-directed therapy reduces hospitalisation and mortality for both (Introduction).
Non-gated CT
Scan not synchronised to the heartbeat. Background, not from the paper: the heart is therefore a blurred 'average' image, normally not used to measure cardiac function.
Non-contrast CT
Background, not from the paper: no contrast agent injected, so vessels and heart chambers have low contrast.
Echocardiography
Cardiac ultrasound, the routine test for measuring EF.
Hounsfield unit HU
Physical unit of CT intensity; this paper uses a [−1000, 1000] HU window to remove air (<−1000 HU) and bone (>1000 HU) (Methods). Background, not from the paper: water is 0 HU.

数据Data

34,058 对 CT–超声、19,410 名患者:CU 25,948 对(EF 降低 16.04%),WCM 8,110 对(17.29%)(Table 1)。CU 保留测试集 5,174 对;时间上更晚的独立测试集 CU 1,411 对、WCM 817 对(Results)。数据不公开,可向作者申请(Data availability)。

34,058 CT–echo pairs, 19,410 patients: Columbia 25,948 pairs (16.04% reduced EF), Weill Cornell 8,110 (17.29%) (Table 1). Columbia hold-out 5,174 pairs; later consecutive test sets 1,411 and 817 pairs (Results). Data available on request only (Data availability).

主要结果Key results

CU 保留测试集 AUROC 0.786 ± 0.005,F1 0.822Results, Fig. 4
WCM 外部验证 AUROC 0.762 ± 0.007,F1 0.812Results §External validation
人口学 + 260 个 ICD-9 码的 XGBoost 基线 AUROC 只有 0.607 / 0.592Table 6
CT–超声间隔 ≤1 天时 CU AUROC 升到 0.800(Holm P=0.004)Table 5
与放射科医生(加权 F1):CU 模型 0.808 vs 0.646、0.802;WCM 模型 0.797 vs 0.623Table 7
时间上更晚的测试集 AUROC 0.742 / 0.735,balanced accuracy 约 0.57Results
无超声的 633 个 CT 中标记 23 人(3.7%),病历核查 18/23(78%)确为 EF 降低并有心衰诊断Results §Opportunistic screening
Columbia hold-out AUROC 0.786 ± 0.005, F1 0.822Results, Fig. 4
Weill Cornell external AUROC 0.762 ± 0.007, F1 0.812Results §External validation
Demographics + 260 ICD-9 codes XGBoost baseline: AUROC 0.607 / 0.592Table 6
CT–echo ≤1 day: Columbia AUROC 0.800 (Holm P=0.004)Table 5
Weighted F1 vs radiologists: CU model 0.808 vs 0.646, 0.802; WCM 0.797 vs 0.623Table 7
Later consecutive cohorts: AUROC 0.742 / 0.735, balanced accuracy ~0.57Results
633 CTs without echo: 23 flagged (3.7%), 18/23 (78%) confirmed reduced EF with heart failure on chart reviewResults §Opportunistic screening

结论Conclusions

作者认为模型能直接从常规非门控非增强胸部 CT 预测 EF 降低,这是该影像的新用途,有望用于早期发现收缩性心衰、缩小诊断缺口(Abstract, Conclusion)。

The authors conclude that reduced LVEF can be predicted directly from routine non-gated non-contrast chest CT, a new use of this imaging that could help detect systolic heart failure early (Abstract, Conclusion).

局限Limitations

  • 作者:回顾性研究,计划前瞻性验证(Discussion)。
  • 作者:2D 超声测 EF 的观察者内差异 8–21%、观察者间差异 6–13%;CT 与超声之间 EF 可能变化,标签有噪声(Discussion)。
  • 作者:只用非增强 CT;Grad-CAM 只有个例定性解释;未研究伪影与低质量扫描的影响(Discussion)。
  • 我们的理解:Grad-CAM 高亮起搏器、胸骨钢丝、置管瘢痕等治疗痕迹,模型可能部分在认“已被治疗的病人”。
  • 我们的理解:时间上更晚的独立测试集上 balanced accuracy 只有约 0.57,默认阈值下对阳性类召回偏低;作者在 Discussion 中选的阈值为 CU 特异度 80%、灵敏度 64%。
  • Authors: retrospective; prospective validation planned (Discussion).
  • Authors: 2D-echo EF has 8–21% intra-observer and 6–13% inter-observer variation, and EF may change between scans, so labels are noisy (Discussion).
  • Authors: non-contrast only; Grad-CAM is case-level and qualitative; artifacts and low-quality scans not studied (Discussion).
  • Our reading: Grad-CAM highlights treatment traces (pacemakers, sternal wires, line scars), so the model may partly detect already-treated patients.
  • Our reading: balanced accuracy is only ~0.57 on the later consecutive test sets, implying low positive-class recall at the default threshold; the authors' chosen threshold gives 80% specificity and 64% sensitivity at CU (Discussion).

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

我们的理解:这是有监督分类,不是异常检测,与 detect 只是间接相关。最值得带回伪影注入课题的是两点:一是“捷径特征”警示——除心脏增大、上腔静脉扩张、肺水肿等心肺表现外,模型也会用与疾病相关但非病理本身的痕迹(起搏器、钢丝、置管瘢痕),肾脏数据里的对应物可能是针道、制片伪影、医院染色风格;二是评估设计——时间上更晚的测试集、按采集条件分层、朴素临床基线、与专家盲法对照,都可写进 KidneyAnomalyBench。

Our reading: supervised classification, not anomaly detection, so only indirectly about "detect". Two lessons for the artifact-injection topic: shortcut features — besides cardiopulmonary findings (enlarged heart, dilated SVC, oedema), the model also uses disease-related traces that are not pathology itself (pacemakers, wires, line scars), and kidney analogues would be needle tracks, preparation artifacts or site staining; and evaluation design — later test cohorts, stratification by acquisition conditions, a naive clinical baseline and a blinded expert comparison, all worth adopting in KidneyAnomalyBench.

CLEAR 把 CT 当作一叠 2D 切片:冻结的自监督编码器给每张切片提特征,ABMIL 注意力聚合成病人级预测;其 LeCL 预训练让对比学习的一路看以病灶为中心的裁剪,使表征更关注异常。2–4 千万参数的模型在三项任务上与 BiomedCLIP 相当或略好。
CLEAR treats CT as a stack of 2D slices: a frozen self-supervised encoder embeds each slice and ABMIL aggregates them; its LeCL pretraining shows one contrastive branch lesion-centred crops so features focus on abnormalities. 22–36M-parameter models match or slightly beat BiomedCLIP on three tasks.

问题Problem

放射学深度学习多是端到端 3D 网络、逐任务微调,还要挑扫描序列、标病灶;病理学已普遍采用“任务无关的自监督基础模型 + 弱监督聚合”,放射学却缺少这样的模型。现有 CT 基础模型要么只针对某个部位(CT-CLIP 胸部、Merlin 腹部),要么跨所有模态过于泛化。作者想要只用 CT、覆盖全身、省算力、对病灶敏感的表征模型。

Radiology relies on end-to-end 3D networks fine-tuned per task, with scan selection and lesion annotation, and lacks task-agnostic representation models like pathology's. The authors want a CT-only, whole-body, compute-friendly, lesion-aware encoder.

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 输入:每个 CT 视为最多 700 张、通常 512×512 的轴位切片;按 DeepLesion 规范把 Hounsfield 值裁到腹部窗(−175 到 275 HU)或肺窗(−1500 到 500 HU)(§4.2)。
  2. 基线预训练:MoCo-v3,InfoNCE 损失,查询编码器 + 动量键编码器(§3.1)。
  3. LeCL:对有病灶框的 DeepLesion 切片,一路编码器看以病灶为中心的裁剪,另一路看同一切片的整图,作为正样本对;可选地在 InfoNCE 分母加 λ·(与所有含病灶关键切片的相似度之和),λ ∈ {0,1,3,5}(§3.2)。
  4. 骨干:ViT-B、VMamba(视觉状态空间模型)、MambaOut(门控 CNN);DeepLesion 873,849 张切片,100 epoch,4 张 A100,25–33 小时(§4.3)。
  5. 下游 CLEAR:冻结编码器逐切片提特征 → 256 维投影 → ABMIL 注意力池化 → LayerNorm + MLP 分类头;多标签任务用 BCE,分期用交叉熵(§3.3, Supp. A)。
  6. 对照:2D 的 BiomedCLIP、SAM2(同样接 ABMIL),3D 的 CT-CLIP、Merlin(只接 MLP 头)(§4.3)。
  7. 评估:任务 1、2 留出测试集 + 5 折;任务 3 嵌套 5 折;报告 AUC、F1、AUPRC;画出切片注意力分布检查是否落在病灶切片(§4.3, Fig. 4)。
  1. Input: each CT is up to 700 axial slices, typically 512×512; Hounsfield units are clipped to DeepLesion windows, abdominal (−175 to 275 HU) or lung (−1500 to 500 HU) (§4.2).
  2. Baseline pretraining: MoCo-v3 with InfoNCE loss, a query encoder and a momentum key encoder (§3.1).
  3. LeCL: for DeepLesion slices with lesion boxes, one encoder branch sees a lesion-centred crop and the other the full image of the same slice, as a positive pair; optionally λ · (sum of similarities to all lesion key slices) is added to the InfoNCE denominator, λ ∈ {0,1,3,5} (§3.2).
  4. Backbones: ViT-B, VMamba (vision state-space model), MambaOut (gated CNN); 873,849 DeepLesion slices, 100 epochs, 4 A100s, 25–33 h (§4.3).
  5. Downstream CLEAR: frozen encoder per slice → 256-d projection → ABMIL attention pooling → LayerNorm + MLP head; BCE for multi-label tasks, cross-entropy for staging (§3.3, Supp. A).
  6. Baselines: 2D BiomedCLIP and SAM2 (also with ABMIL), 3D CT-CLIP and Merlin (MLP head only) (§4.3).
  7. Evaluation: held-out test set + 5-fold CV for Tasks 1–2, nested 5-fold CV for Task 3; AUC, F1 and AUPRC; slice-attention plots checked against lesion slices (§4.3, Fig. 4).

术语Terms

CT 计算机断层扫描
背景知识(非本文内容):用 X 射线从多角度成像并重建出的 3D 影像。本文把每个 CT 视为一叠 2D 轴位切片。
轴位切片 axial slice
背景知识(非本文内容):与身体长轴垂直的横断面图像;本文每个 CT 最多 700 张,通常 512×512。
Hounsfield 单位 HU
CT 中存储的数值(本文写范围 −1024 到 1024);按窗口裁剪以突出结构,如腹部窗 −175 到 275、肺窗 −1500 到 500。
病灶 lesion
影像上可见的异常区域,如肿瘤;DeepLesion 为病灶提供边界框标注。
NSCLC 非小细胞肺癌
本文任务 3 的数据集;把分期分为低(I–II)与高(III–IV)。
DeepLesion
公开 CT 数据集:14,601 个增强 CT、4,427 名患者,所有 CT 有病灶框。
CT (computed tomography)
Background, not from the paper: a 3D image reconstructed from X-ray projections. The paper treats each CT as a stack of 2D axial slices.
Axial slice
Background, not from the paper: a cross-section perpendicular to the body's long axis; here up to 700 per CT, typically 512×512.
Hounsfield unit (HU)
The value stored in CT (range −1024 to 1024 per the paper); clipped to windows to show structures, e.g. abdominal −175 to 275, lung −1500 to 500.
Lesion
A visible abnormal region such as a tumour; DeepLesion gives bounding boxes for lesions.
NSCLC
Non-small-cell lung cancer; the Task 3 dataset, staged low (I–II) vs high (III–IV).
DeepLesion
Public CT dataset: 14,601 contrast CTs from 4,427 patients, all with lesion boxes.

数据Data

DeepLesion:14,601 个增强 CT、4,427 名实体瘤患者,病灶覆盖骨、肺、纵隔、肝、肾、腹部、软组织、盆腔;4,177 个 CT(1,368 名患者)有部位标签;839 名患者(20%)留作测试。RadChest:3,630 个平扫胸部 CT,多种肺部异常(外部任务 2)。NSCLC-Radiomics:422 名患者的 447 个平扫 CT,预测低(I–II)/ 高(III–IV)分期(外部任务 3)。

DeepLesion: 14,601 contrast CTs from 4,427 patients with solid tumours in bone, lung, mediastinum, liver, kidney, abdomen, soft tissue and pelvis; 4,177 scans (1,368 patients) have location labels; 839 patients (20%) held out as the test set. RadChest: 3,630 non-contrast chest CTs with several lung abnormalities (external Task 2). NSCLC-Radiomics: 447 non-contrast CTs from 422 patients, low (I–II) vs high (III–IV) stage (external Task 3).

结论Conclusions

作者认为:冻结表征 + 弱监督的 CLEAR 框架在减少人工标注的同时提升了性能,LeCL 能学到病灶感知的表征;同时现有放射学表征模型仍有明显局限,需要更多领域专用的表征学习研究。

The authors conclude that the CLEAR framework of frozen representations plus weak supervision improves performance while reducing manual annotation, that LeCL learns lesion-aware representations, and that current radiology representation models remain clearly limited, calling for more domain-specific representation learning.

局限Limitations

  • (作者)放射学表征学习现状仍然有限,Merlin、CT-CLIP 等现有方法在所有任务上表现较差;我们的理解:本文模型的绝对 AUC 也不高(约 67–78)。
  • 我们的理解:LeCL 相对 MoCo / BiomedCLIP 的提升多为 0.3–3 个 AUC 点,而标准差 1.6–5.0,“全面优于”偏强,无显著性检验。
  • 我们的理解:预训练和任务 1 都来自 DeepLesion;外部任务只有胸部;2D 切片忽略层间 3D 信息。
  • 我们的理解:文中称开源,但 v1 预印本没有代码或权重链接。
  • 我们的理解:论文内部有几处不一致 —— Supp. Table 6 的任务 2 AUC 比 Table 2 同一模型低约 4 点;VMamba 在 λ = 3 而非 λ = 5 时最低;「839 名患者」按数字推算更像是 CT 数。
  • (Authors) representation learning for radiology is still limited; existing methods such as Merlin and CT-CLIP perform poorly on all tasks. Our reading: the paper's own absolute AUCs are also modest (about 67–78).
  • Our reading: LeCL's gains over MoCo / BiomedCLIP are mostly 0.3–3 AUC points against standard deviations of 1.6–5.0, so "outperforms" is a strong claim; no significance tests.
  • Our reading: pretraining and Task 1 both come from DeepLesion; the external tasks are chest-only; 2D slices ignore inter-slice 3D information.
  • Our reading: the paper calls the model open source, but the v1 preprint gives no code or weight link.
  • Our reading: the paper is internally inconsistent in places — Task 2 AUCs in Supp. Table 6 are ~4 points below Table 2 for the same models; VMamba is lowest at λ = 3, not λ = 5; and by arithmetic the "839 patients" looks like a count of scans.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

这篇不是异常检测,而是“让表征对异常更敏感”的预训练,处在 detect 之前的表征层。我们的理解:CLEAR 的“冻结单元嵌入 + ABMIL + 注意力图”与肾脏活检中“细胞 / spot 嵌入 → 样本标签 → 注意力定位异常区域”的弱监督思路一致,可作伪影注入课题中 detect 环节的有监督对照;LeCL 需要病灶标注,与只用正常数据的异常检测设定不同。

Not an anomaly detector but abnormality-aware pretraining at the representation layer before detect. Our reading: CLEAR's "frozen unit embeddings + ABMIL + attention map" mirrors the weakly supervised pattern in kidney biopsies (cell / spot embeddings → sample label → attention on abnormal regions) and can serve as a supervised comparator for the detect stage in the artifact-injection topic; LeCL needs lesion labels, unlike normal-only anomaly detection.

A deep learning algorithm to predict risk of pancreatic cancer from disease trajectories

Placido D, Yuan B, Hjaltelin JX, Zheng C, et al. A deep learning algorithm to predict risk of pancreatic cancer from disease trajectories. Nature Medicine. 2023;29:1113-1122.

doi:10.1038/s41591-023-02332-5 · source.pdf

全文已读full text readPDF
论文 PDF 全文(pdftotext;正文、Methods、Extended Data 图注;未读补充材料)
full PDF via pdftotext (main text, Methods, Extended Data captions; supplement not read)
CancerRiskNet:只用带时间戳的 ICD 诊断码序列(疾病轨迹),在丹麦 620 万人(23,985 例胰腺癌)上训练 Transformer,预测 3–60 个月内是否发生胰腺癌;36 个月 AUROC 0.879,迁移到美国 VA 降为 0.710,本地重训为 0.775。
CancerRiskNet: a Transformer on timestamped ICD code sequences from 6.2M Danish patients (23,985 pancreatic cancers) predicts cancer within 3–60 months; 36-month AUROC 0.879, 0.710 when transferred to US-VA, 0.775 after local retraining.

问题Problem

约 80% 的胰腺癌确诊时已是晚期,5 年生存 2–9%,而早期可以治愈。发病率低,全人群筛查不现实,现有监测只覆盖有家族史、遗传变异或囊肿的少数人。作者想从常规临床记录中挑出数量适中的高危人群,让昂贵的影像监测可负担。此前的 EHR 模型只用诊断码是否出现,不用时间顺序。

About 80% of pancreatic cancers are found late (2–9% five-year survival), yet early disease is curable. Low incidence makes population screening impractical, and surveillance covers only a few people with family history, inherited variants or cysts. The authors want to pick a moderate high-risk group from routine records so imaging surveillance becomes affordable. Earlier EHR models used code occurrence, not time order.

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 输入:每个病人的 (ICD 三位码, 日期, 年龄) 事件序列;丹麦数据中 ICD-8 与 ICD-10 不做映射直接共用;去掉 temporary/referral 码。
  2. 样本构造:对每个病人取所有从病史起点开始、≥5 个诊断、终点不同的前缀子轨迹(终点 = 评估时刻);病例只用确诊前结束的,对照只用在记录结束前 ≥2 年结束的;batch 内正负平衡采样。
  3. 标签:在 3/6/12/36/60 个月处的阶跃函数,即 5 个共享表示的二分类任务。
  4. 模型:诊断码 embedding → GRU 或 Transformer 编码(Transformer 用 128 个频率的余弦编码,取值于诊断年龄与诊断间隔)→ 前馈网络输出 5 个时间窗风险;对照为 bag-of-words 与 MLP。
  5. 损失:5 个时间点交叉熵之和 + L2;按病人 80/10/10 随机划分,开发集上用 AUPRC 选模型。
  6. 数据排除:分别重训,删掉确诊前最后 3/6/12 个月的诊断,检验模型是否只读近确诊的码。
  7. 评估:AUROC,以及 RR = precision / 人群发病率,在「100 万人中前 1,000 名」(N1000)处读数;200 次 bootstrap 给 CI;指标按子轨迹计算。
  8. 跨系统与解释:丹麦模型只做 ICD 映射后用于 VA,再在 VA 上重训;用 Integrated Gradients 按距确诊时间分层看特征贡献。
  1. Input: each patient's sequence of (three-character ICD code, date, age) events; in the Danish data ICD-8 and ICD-10 are used side by side without mapping; temporary/referral codes are removed.
  2. Sample construction: for each patient, all prefix sub-trajectories from the start of the history with ≥5 diagnoses and different endpoints (endpoint = time of assessment); cases use only those ending before diagnosis, controls only those ending ≥2 years before the end of their records; positives and negatives are balanced in each batch.
  3. Labels: step functions at 3/6/12/36/60 months, i.e. five binary targets on a shared representation.
  4. Model: code embedding → GRU or Transformer encoder (the Transformer uses cosine encodings at 128 frequencies, evaluated at age of diagnosis and inter-diagnosis intervals) → feed-forward network giving risk for the five windows; bag-of-words and MLP as baselines.
  5. Loss: cross-entropy summed over the five time points + L2; random 80/10/10 split by patient; model selection by AUPRC on the development set.
  6. Data exclusion: retrain separately with diagnoses from the last 3/6/12 months before diagnosis removed, to test whether the model only reads near-diagnosis codes.
  7. Evaluation: AUROC, and RR = precision / population incidence, read at the top 1,000 of 1M (N1000); 95% CIs from 200 bootstrap resamples; metrics computed over sub-trajectories.
  8. Cross-system and interpretation: apply the Danish model to VA after ICD mapping only, then retrain on VA; Integrated Gradients, stratified by time to cancer, for feature contributions.

术语Terms

ICD 码 ICD code
国际疾病分类的诊断编码;本文截到三位字符类别,如 C25 = 胰腺恶性肿瘤。
疾病轨迹 disease trajectory
一个病人按时间排列的诊断序列。
DNPR
丹麦全国患者登记,1977 年起的医院诊断,不含全科医生记录。
US-VA CDW
美国退伍军人事务部的企业数据仓库,整合 EHR 与癌症登记。
癌症登记 cancer registry
由专职人员人工核实的癌症病例库,比 EHR 诊断码更可靠。
相对风险 RR
高危组中的发病比例除以人群发病率,即比随机挑人好多少倍。
PPV
阳性预测值:被判为高危的人中真正发病的比例。(背景知识,非本文定义)
ICD code
International Classification of Diseases diagnosis code; this paper truncates codes to the three-character category, e.g. C25 = malignant neoplasm of pancreas.
Disease trajectory
A patient's time-ordered sequence of diagnoses.
DNPR
Danish National Patient Registry: hospital diagnoses since 1977, no general-practitioner records.
US-VA CDW
US Veterans Affairs Corporate Data Warehouse, combining EHR and cancer-registry data.
Cancer registry
A database of cancer cases checked by hand by trained registrars; more reliable than EHR diagnosis codes.
Relative risk (RR)
Cancer rate in the high-risk group divided by the population incidence, i.e. how many times better than a random pick.
PPV
Positive predictive value: the fraction of people flagged as high risk who actually develop the disease. (background, not from the paper)

数据Data

丹麦 DNPR:1977–2018 年约 860 万人、2.29 亿条医院诊断;过滤后训练用 620 万人、23,985 例胰腺癌;与癌症登记重合 88%。US-VA:1999–2020 年,从 1,590 万人中随机抽约 300 万,病例定义为登记与 EHR 码同时存在,最终 1,948,209 人、3,418 例(论文不同位置给出的 VA 数字不一致)。VA 每人诊断码中位数 188(丹麦 22),轨迹中位 12 年(丹麦 23 年),男性占 85.7%。

Danish DNPR: ~8.6M patients and 229M hospital diagnoses (1977–2018); 6.2M patients and 23,985 cases after filtering; 88% overlap with the cancer registry. US-VA: ~3M sampled from 15.9M (1999–2020); cases = registry and EHR code both present; final 1,948,209 patients and 3,418 cases (VA counts differ across the paper). VA has median 188 codes per patient vs 22, 12 vs 23 years of history, and is 85.7% male.

结论Conclusions

使用疾病史的时间顺序比只用诊断是否出现更能预测胰腺癌,尤其在最高风险组。目前不存在一个跨国通用的模型,医疗系统差异大时需要本地独立训练。这一性能水平可能足以支撑真实监测项目的初步设计。

Using the time sequence of disease histories improves prediction over code occurrence, especially for the highest-risk group. No single globally robust model exists yet; independent local training is needed when health systems differ. The performance may suffice for initial design of real surveillance programmes.

局限Limitations

  • 作者所述:只用诊断码,未用用药、化验、文本、影像、遗传与全科记录。
  • 作者所述:跨系统迁移性能明显下降,联邦学习只是被提议;没有成本-收益的实证数据;只解决「识别高危」这第一步。
  • 作者所述:IG 特征与结局之间不一定是因果关系。
  • 我们的理解:按病人随机划分而非按时间划分,没有检验时间漂移;指标按子轨迹计算;论文内若干数字不一致。
  • Authors: diagnosis codes only (no medications, labs, notes, imaging, genetics, GP records).
  • Authors: weak cross-system transfer; federated learning only proposed; no empirical cost–benefit; addresses only the first step (identifying high-risk patients).
  • Authors: IG features are not necessarily causal.
  • Our reading: random rather than temporal split; metrics over trajectories; several internal numeric inconsistencies.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

对 Mount Sinai EHR 项目:我们的理解:最值得照搬的是评估协议 —— 前缀子轨迹、对照 2 年截断、3/6/12 个月数据排除、RR@前 0.1%、外部模型直接迁移作基线对比本地重训;Sinai 与 VA 同为美国系统,应以本地训练为主,最好加按时间划分的测试集,病例标签需肿瘤登记或病理确认。同一协议可换成 CKD 进展、透析、心衰等终点。与 detect → model → revert 的关系(我们的理解):这是病人尺度的 detect,回答「谁、何时」,不回答「为什么、改什么」;可从 EHR 高危人群中选出有活检/组学数据的病人再做组织层异常检测。

For the Mount Sinai EHR project — Our reading: copy the evaluation protocol (prefix sub-trajectories, 2-year control truncation, 3/6/12-month exclusion, RR at top 0.1%, direct transfer as a baseline vs local retraining); as a US system like VA, Sinai should rely on local training, ideally with a temporal test split and registry- or pathology-confirmed labels; the protocol can target CKD progression, dialysis or heart failure. Relative to detect → model → revert (our reading): patient-scale detect — who and when, not why or what to change; EHR-flagged patients with biopsies/omics could feed tissue-level anomaly detection.

Learning the natural history of human disease with generative transformers

Shmatko A, Jung AW, Gaurav K, Brunak S, et al. Learning the natural history of human disease with generative transformers. Nature. 2025;647:248-256.

doi:10.1038/s41586-025-09529-3 · source.pdf

全文已读full text readPDF
论文 PDF 全文(pdftotext;正文、Methods、Extended Data 图注;未读补充材料)
full PDF via pdftotext (main text, Methods, Extended Data captions; supplement not read)
Delphi-2M 把 GPT-2 改成连续时间、竞争风险的疾病生成模型:根据一个人的诊断史同时预测下一事件是哪种病和多久之后发生;220 万参数,在 40 万 UK Biobank 人上训练,>1,000 种疾病平均 AUC 约 0.76,不改参数用于 193 万丹麦人为 0.67。
Delphi-2M turns GPT-2 into a continuous-time, competing-risk generative disease model that predicts which disease comes next and when; 2.2M parameters trained on 0.4M UK Biobank participants, average AUC ~0.76 over >1,000 diseases and 0.67 on 1.93M Danes without retraining.

问题Problem

现有风险模型大多只针对单一疾病,很少能同时预测 ICD-10 顶层 >1,000 种诊断。多病共病建模要处理诊断种类多、事件间时间依赖、数据整合和校准等难点。疾病史和语言一样是序列,作者问:GPT 式模型能否学到人类疾病的「自然史」,并且可校准、可生成、可外部验证?

Most risk models target one disease; few predict the >1,000 top-level ICD-10 diagnoses jointly. Multimorbidity modelling must handle many diagnoses, temporal dependencies, data integration and calibration. Disease histories are sequences like text — can a GPT-style model learn the natural history of disease while staying calibrated, generative and externally valid?

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 序列:每个数据点是 (token, 年龄[天]);token 为 ICD-10 三位码首诊(1,256 种)、死亡、性别、BMI/吸烟/饮酒各 3 级,以及 no-event 填充。
  2. no-event 填充:平均每 5 年插入 1 个,消除长空窗,推理时可在任意时刻查询风险;生活方式 token 的时间在入组点 −20 到 +40 年间随机化,以免 immortal-time bias 造成虚假关联。
  3. 架构(nanoGPT 的 GPT-2):位置编码换成年龄的 sin/cos 编码 + 可训练线性变换;因果注意力额外屏蔽同一时刻记录的 token;输入 embedding 与输出投影权重绑定。
  4. 竞争指数损失:logit 即对数速率 λ = exp(logit);下一事件概率 λj/Σλ 就是 softmax 交叉熵;到下一事件的时间服从速率 Σλ 的指数分布,另加其对数似然;性别与生活方式只作输入,不进损失。
  5. 规模:扫描 486 个模型,复现 scaling law,UKB 规模最优约 200 万参数;选 120 维、12 层、12 头,共 220 万参数;Adam,20 万次迭代,batch 128。
  6. 采样:从 softmax 采下一疾病,从各指数分布采时间取最小值,迭代生成整条未来轨迹。
  7. 评估:5 年年龄段、分性别计算 AUC 后平均;纵向测试在截止日后空 1 年;对照 QRisk3、SCORE2、PREVENT、Framingham、UKBDRS、Charlson、Elixhauser、AutoPrognosis、Transformer、Llama3.1-8B、MILTON;丹麦数据零调参外部测试。
  8. 解释:embedding 的 UMAP、SHAP(与 Cox 风险比对照)、注意力图、按数据来源的偏倚分析。
  1. Sequence: each datapoint is (token, age in days); tokens are first ICD-10 three-character diagnoses (1,256), death, sex, 3-level BMI/smoking/alcohol, and no-event padding.
  2. No-event padding: inserted at an average of 1 per 5 years to remove long gaps, so risk can be queried at any time at inference; lifestyle token times are randomised by −20 to +40 years around enrolment to avoid spurious associations from immortal-time bias.
  3. Architecture (GPT-2 via nanoGPT): positional encoding replaced by sin/cos age encoding plus a trainable linear map; causal attention additionally masks tokens recorded at the same time; input embedding and output projection weights are tied.
  4. Competing-exponential loss: logits are log-rates, λ = exp(logit); P(next = j) = λj/Σλ is exactly softmax cross-entropy; the time to the next event is exponential with rate Σλ, whose log-likelihood is added; sex and lifestyle are inputs only and excluded from the loss.
  5. Scale: a 486-model screen reproduces scaling laws, with ~2M parameters optimal at UKB scale; the chosen model has 120-d embeddings, 12 layers, 12 heads, 2.2M parameters; Adam, 200k iterations, batch 128.
  6. Sampling: the next disease is drawn from the softmax, the time as the minimum of draws from all exponentials, iterated into a full future trajectory.
  7. Evaluation: AUC within 5-year age brackets by sex, then averaged; longitudinal testing with a 1-year gap after the cut-off; baselines QRisk3, SCORE2, PREVENT, Framingham, UKBDRS, Charlson, Elixhauser, AutoPrognosis, Transformer, Llama3.1-8B, MILTON; zero-tuning external test on Danish data.
  8. Interpretation: UMAP of embeddings, SHAP (compared with Cox hazard ratios), attention maps, and bias analysis by data source.

术语Terms

UK Biobank
约 50 万名英国参与者的前瞻性队列,2006–2010 年入组(入组时 37–73 岁);疾病数据链接初级保健、住院、死亡登记和自报问卷。
ICD-10
国际疾病分类第 10 版;本文用三位字符码,如 E11 = 2 型糖尿病。
竞争风险 competing risks
多种事件互相竞争「谁先发生」;本文模型中,等待时间最短的那个事件就是下一事件。
发病率 incidence rate
单位时间内新发某病的速率;本文模型的 logit 是对数速率,速率 λ = exp(logit)(每天)。
immortal-time bias
入组者必须在入组时活着,所以入组前不会有死亡记录,造成生存时间的系统偏差。
HbA1c
糖化血红蛋白;本文指出它在临床上用于糖尿病的风险预测和诊断。
QRisk3 / SCORE2
临床常用的心血管病风险评分,本文用作 CVD 对照基线。
UK Biobank
Prospective cohort of ~500,000 UK participants recruited 2006–2010 (aged 37–73 at recruitment); disease data link primary care, hospital admissions, the death registry and self-report questionnaires.
ICD-10
International Classification of Diseases, 10th revision; the paper uses three-character codes, e.g. E11 = type 2 diabetes.
Competing risks
Several events compete to happen first; in this model the event with the shortest waiting time is the next event.
Incidence rate
The rate of new cases per unit time; the model's logits are log-rates, rate λ = exp(logit) (per day).
Immortal-time bias
Participants had to be alive when recruited, so no deaths are recorded before recruitment, which biases survival times.
HbA1c
Glycated haemoglobin; the paper notes it is used clinically for risk prediction and diagnosis of diabetes.
QRisk3 / SCORE2
Clinical cardiovascular risk scores, used as CVD baselines in the paper.

数据Data

UK Biobank 约 50 万人(训练 402,799,验证 100,639;纵向测试 471,057 名 2020-07-01 仍在世者,评估 2021-07 至 2022-07 的发病)。疾病来自 UKB first-occurrence 数据加癌症登记,共 1,256 种 ICD-10 诊断。外部测试:丹麦患者登记与死因登记,2016-01-01 时 50–80 岁的 193 万人、1,151 万个疾病 token;评估 2017 年发病,覆盖 796 个 ICD-10 码。

UK Biobank ~500k (train 402,799, validation 100,639; longitudinal test 471,057 alive on 1 July 2020, evaluated July 2021–July 2022). First-occurrence data plus cancer registry give 1,256 ICD-10 diagnoses. External test: Danish patient and cause-of-death registries, 1.93M people aged 50–80 on 1 January 2016, 11.51M disease tokens; 2017 incidence over 796 ICD-10 codes.

主要结果Key results

内部验证下一事件平均年龄-性别分层 AUC ≈0.76;97% 的诊断 AUC > 0.5;死亡 AUC 0.97Fig. 2b; Results

结论Conclusions

Transformer 模型适合健康数据的预测与生成任务:单一模型对多数疾病的准确度可比或优于专用单病种模型,迁移到丹麦只小幅下降,并能估计最长 20 年的疾病负担。作者告诫不要把模型学到的时间依赖当作可用于干预的因果关系,并指出模型也学到了数据采集带来的偏倚。

Transformer models suit predictive and generative health tasks: one model matches or exceeds single-disease models for most outcomes, transfers to Denmark with a small drop, and estimates disease burden up to 20 years. The authors caution against reading learned temporal dependencies as causal levers and show the model also learns data-collection biases.

局限Limitations

  • 作者所述:UKB 健康志愿者偏倚、入组前无死亡、80 岁以上数据稀少;模型利用了数据来源缺失模式。
  • 作者所述:时间依赖不能当作因果;个体预测受随机性影响大;临床应用还需监管框架。
  • 作者所述:只有首诊与少量生活方式,糖尿病等疾病仍离不开生物标志物。
  • 我们的理解:只用「首次」诊断,丢掉复发与分期进展,对 CKD 分期这类病可能不够;外部验证只评估一年、只覆盖 50–80 岁。
  • Authors: UKB healthy-volunteer bias, no pre-recruitment deaths, sparse data above 80; data-source missingness exploited.
  • Authors: dependencies are not causal; individual predictions strongly influenced by chance; regulatory framework needed.
  • Authors: first diagnoses and few lifestyle factors only; biomarkers still indispensable for diseases like diabetes.
  • Our reading: first-occurrence only loses recurrence and stage progression (e.g. CKD stages); external test covers one year and ages 50–80.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

对 Mount Sinai EHR 项目:我们的理解:Delphi-2M 是小而可复现(代码公开)的病人轨迹基础模型模板,与胰腺癌轨迹论文的单病种判别模型互补;竞争指数头适合把 CKD 进展、透析、心衰、死亡等竞争终点放进一个模型;Sinai 规模下的最优模型大小本身可检验;它在糖尿病上输给 HbA1c,提示需要把化验值和用药作为输入(需先确认 Sinai 数据中有这些字段);单中心 EHR 的就诊缺失偏倚需要分层检验。与 detect → model → revert 的关系(我们的理解):Delphi 是病人尺度的 model(可采样的虚拟病人),但不能做因果干预,要到 revert 还需要因果层或与组织层 virtual tissue 的连接。

For the Mount Sinai EHR project — Our reading: a small, reproducible (public code) template for a patient-trajectory foundation model, complementing the single-disease pancreatic model; the competing-exponential head suits competing endpoints such as CKD progression, dialysis, heart failure and death; optimal model size at Sinai scale is testable; losing to HbA1c suggests adding labs and medications (if Sinai has them — to confirm); single-centre care-gap missingness needs stratified checks. Relative to detect → model → revert (our reading): a patient-scale model (sampleable virtual patient) without causal claims; reaching revert needs a causal layer or a link to tissue-scale virtual tissue.

A machine learning approach to leveraging electronic health records for enhanced omics analysis

Mataraso SJ, Espinosa CA, Seong D, et al. A machine learning approach to leveraging electronic health records for enhanced omics analysis. Nat Mach Intell. 2025;7:293–306.

doi:10.1038/s42256-024-00974-9 · source.pdf

全文已读full text readPDF
出版社 PDF 全文(pdftotext;Nat. Mach. Intell. 7:293–306,CC BY 4.0);补充材料未读
full publisher PDF via pdftotext (Nat. Mach. Intell. 7:293–306, CC BY 4.0); supplement not read
COMET 先在「只有 EHR」的大队列上预训练 GRU,再把冻结权重迁移到 EHR + 蛋白组的多模态网络(早融合与晚融合的自适应混合),在 61 人妊娠和 559 人 UK Biobank 癌症蛋白组上都优于同结构无预训练的基线。
COMET pretrains a GRU on a large EHR-only cohort and transfers the frozen weights into an EHR + proteomics network that blends early and late fusion, beating a same-architecture baseline without pretraining on a 61-person pregnancy cohort and a 559-person UK Biobank cancer cohort.

问题Problem

组学队列通常很小(几十到几百人),容易过拟合、难复现;而同一来源的 EHR 有数万人。早/中融合要求两种模态都完整,会丢掉只有 EHR 的病人;晚融合学不到跨模态交互。如何用大量只有 EHR 的病人帮助小组学队列的建模和生物学发现?

Omics cohorts are small and overfit-prone while matching EHRs cover tens of thousands; early fusion drops EHR-only patients and late fusion misses cross-modal interactions. How can many EHR-only patients help a small omics cohort?

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 从 OMOP 的 measurement、observation、drug_exposure、condition_occurrence、procedure_occurrence 表取概念码。
  2. 同一病人同一天的码当作一个「句子」(打乱顺序),word2vec 学 400 维码嵌入,同日取均值,最多用最近 32 天。
  3. 在只有 EHR 的预训练队列上训练 GRU,预测与目标相同的结局:距分娩天数(MSE)或 3 年癌症死亡(BCE)。
  4. 多模态网络三支:迁移并冻结的 EHR GRU、组学支(线性层或单隐层 MLP)、EHR 潜表示与组学拼接的 joint 支;最后用无偏置线性层把三个预测加权合成。
  5. 对照:仅 EHR、仅组学、同结构无预训练的 joint baseline;带预训练先验的 ridge / logistic;Transformer 变体。每个实验用 25 次 70/15/15 划分重复。
  6. 生物学分析:EHR 潜维度与蛋白的显著相关数、Integrated Gradients 蛋白重要性;在「COMET 比基线更重视」的蛋白中取最重要的 50 个(基线一组反之),在外部数据集中检验(外部数据中找到 14 / 12 个(妊娠)、18 / 18 个(癌症));parameter space 轨迹(由网络输出构建的 t-SNE)。
  1. Extract concept codes from the OMOP measurement, observation, drug_exposure, condition_occurrence and procedure_occurrence tables.
  2. Treat each patient-day's codes as a shuffled "sentence"; word2vec learns 400-d code embeddings, averaged per day, using up to the 32 most recent days.
  3. Pretrain a GRU on EHR-only patients for the same outcome as the target: days to labour (MSE) or 3-year cancer mortality (BCE).
  4. Multimodal network with three branches: the transferred, frozen EHR GRU; an omics branch (a linear layer or a one-hidden-layer MLP); a joint branch on concatenated EHR latent + omics; a bias-free linear layer weights the three predictions.
  5. Comparators: EHR-only, omics-only and a same-architecture joint baseline without pretraining; ridge/logistic with pretrained priors; a Transformer variant. Each experiment is repeated over 25 random 70/15/15 splits.
  6. Biology analyses: significant EHR-latent–protein correlations, Integrated-Gradients protein importance; the 50 most important proteins among those weighted more by COMET than by the baseline (and vice versa) tested in external datasets (14 / 12 found for pregnancy, 18 / 18 for cancer); parameter-space trajectories (t-SNE built from network outputs).

术语Terms

组学 omics
一次从一个样本测大量分子(如蛋白质组、代谢组)的检测。
蛋白组 proteomics
测血浆中上千种蛋白的丰度;本文用适配体(aptamer)平台。
代谢组 metabolomics
背景知识:测小分子代谢物的丰度。
UK Biobank
超过 50 万英国参与者的大型生物库;本文用到其 EHR(OMOP 格式)和部分参与者的蛋白组(53,058 人)。
OMOP
背景知识:统一的 EHR 数据格式与词表(本文两个数据集的 EHR 都是 OMOP 格式)。
早融合 / 晚融合
在特征层合并模态 vs 合并各模态各自的预测。
Omics
Assays measuring many molecules (e.g. proteome, metabolome) from a single sample.
Proteomics
Abundance of over a thousand plasma proteins; this paper uses an aptamer-based platform.
Metabolomics
Background, not from the paper: abundance of small-molecule metabolites.
UK Biobank
Biobank of over half a million UK participants; this paper uses its EHR (OMOP format) and the proteomics measured for a subset (53,058 participants).
OMOP
Background, not from the paper: a common EHR data format and vocabulary (both datasets' EHR are in OMOP format here).
Early / late fusion
Merging modalities at the feature level vs combining the modality-specific predictions.

数据Data

妊娠:Stanford 2013–2021 年 30,904 名分娩者,其中 61 人(171 份血浆样本,1,305 个蛋白)有蛋白组,30,843 人用于预训练。癌症:UK Biobank 36,901 名癌症患者,其中 559 人在确诊后 12 个月内有入组血样蛋白组(中位 2,894 个蛋白),36,342 人用于预训练;3 年死亡率 5.5%。

Pregnancy: 30,904 Stanford deliveries; 61 with proteomics (171 samples, 1,305 proteins), 30,843 for pretraining. Cancer: 36,901 UK Biobank cancer patients; 559 with proteomics within 12 months of diagnosis, 36,342 for pretraining; 3-year mortality 5.5%.

主要结果Key results

距分娩天数 Pearson r 0.868(RMSE 16.0 天);joint baseline 0.815,仅蛋白 0.796,仅 EHR 0.768Results;Fig. 2c

EHR 潜维度–蛋白显著相关数:妊娠 3,201 → 5,364;癌症 0 → 7,591Results;Figs. 3、5
COMET 重要蛋白在外部妊娠数据中平均 |r| 0.22 vs 基线 0.12(p=0.0276);癌症 9/18 vs 8/18Figs. 3d、5d
Days to labour Pearson r 0.868 (RMSE 16.0 days); joint baseline 0.815, proteins only 0.796, EHR only 0.768Results; Fig. 2c
Metabolomics: COMET 0.839 vs metabolites only 0.758Results

EHR-latent–protein correlations 3,201 → 5,364 (pregnancy), 0 → 7,591 (cancer)Results; Figs. 3, 5
COMET-important proteins in external pregnancy data: mean |r| 0.22 vs baseline 0.12 (p = 0.0276); cancer 9/18 vs 8/18Figs. 3d, 5d

结论Conclusions

作者认为 EHR 预训练对整个网络起到「通过初始化实现的正则化」作用,使模型在小组学队列上预测更好、所依赖的蛋白更符合已知生物学;据作者所知这是首个用 EHR 迁移学习改善组学分析的方法。

The authors argue that EHR pretraining acts as regularization by initialization, improving prediction and biological plausibility in small omics cohorts, and that COMET is the first approach to use EHR transfer learning for omics analysis.

局限Limitations

  • 作者自述:对需要更复杂组学结构的模态(如空间转录组)是否有效未知;OMOP 映射可能有误;预训练需要带标签的 EHR 任务。
  • 我们的理解:组学队列仅 61 / 559 人,癌症 AUROC 的 CI(0.744–0.922)与基线(0.664–0.882)大幅重叠。
  • 我们的理解:外部验证是间接的(重要蛋白的单变量关联),癌症中 9/18 vs 8/18 差别很小;EHR 表示较粗(日均 word2vec、仅最近 32 天)。
  • Authors: unknown for omics needing complex architectures (e.g. spatial transcriptomics); OMOP mapping errors; labelled pretraining required.
  • Our reading: the omics cohorts have only 61 / 559 people; the cancer AUROC CI (0.744–0.922) overlaps heavily with the baseline's (0.664–0.882).
  • Our reading: external validation is indirect (univariate associations of important proteins), and 9/18 vs 8/18 in cancer is a small difference; the EHR representation is coarse (daily-averaged word2vec, last 32 days only).

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

对 Sinai EHR 项目(我们的理解):这是这批 EHR 论文中唯一连接 EHR 与分子数据的一篇;「大 EHR 预训练 → 小组学队列迁移」对应 EHR 多、组学少的不对称;把结局换成 CKD 进展、预训练任务换成 eGFR 下降或进入透析,即可在 Sinai 上复现,并照用同结构无预训练的消融、潜表示–分子相关计数和外部验证。我们的理解:对 detect → model → revert,作者把空间转录组列为未知,而 the artifact-injection topic 面对的正是这类多模态肾脏组学设计;EHR 病人表示可作为样本级先验,帮助区分临床异常与技术伪迹;但 COMET 是相关性的,重要蛋白不等于可干预靶点。

For the Sinai EHR project (our reading): the only paper in this EHR batch linking EHR to molecular data; big-EHR pretraining → small omics/biopsy transfer fits a many-EHR / few-omics setting, e.g. with CKD progression as the outcome. Our reading: for detect → model → revert, EHR patient representations could act as sample-level priors to separate clinical abnormality from technical artefact in kidney omics (the artifact-injection topic), but the link is correlational.
