Virtual Cell Challenge

Roohani YH, Hua TJ, Tung PY, et al. Virtual Cell Challenge: Toward a Turing test for the virtual cell. Cell. 2025;188(13):3370-3374.

doi:10.1016/j.cell.2025.06.008 · 没有本地 PDF（见下方来源说明）No local PDF (see source note)

网页 / READMEweb page / README无本地 PDFno local PDF
Arc Institute 官方网页(发布公告、Behind the data、2025 总结、2026 公告、State 新闻页)+ Cell 评论摘要;Cell 全文未获取
Arc Institute pages (launch, Behind the data, 2025 wrap-up, 2026 announcement, State news) + Cell commentary abstract; full Cell text not obtained
Arc Institute 的年度公开竞赛:在 H1 人胚胎干细胞里,根据部分基因被 CRISPRi 敲低后的单细胞数据,预测其余未见过的敲低会让细胞表达怎样变化。
Arc Institute's annual open competition: from single-cell data on some CRISPRi knockdowns in H1 human embryonic stem cells, predict how unseen knockdowns change the cells' expression.

问题Problem

virtual cell(细胞状态模型)的核心目标之一是预测细胞对扰动的反应,但研究者一直难以比较不同方法,因为评测方法不一致、数据质量参差(发布公告)。Arc 用一个每年举办的开放竞赛提供评测框架、专门数据和交流场所(Cell 摘要),并检验模型能否泛化到新的细胞语境;第一届设计成 few-shot,发放一部分 H1 训练数据(发布公告)。

A key goal of virtual-cell models is predicting responses to perturbation, but researchers have struggled to compare approaches because of inconsistent evaluation methods and varying dataset quality (launch page). Arc runs a recurring open competition to provide an evaluation framework, purpose-built data and a venue (Cell abstract), and to test generalisation to a new cell context; the first edition is few-shot, with a released training subset of H1 cells (launch page).

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 预筛:在 H1 细胞中做大规模 CRISPRi 预筛,统计每个扰动引起的差异表达基因数(Behind the data)。
  2. 选靶点:按反应强度分档抽样,并用 ContrastiveVI+ 在隐空间聚类,保证 300 个靶基因覆盖不同的反应模式(Behind the data)。
  3. 生成数据:双 guide CRISPRi(dCas9-KRAB 压低转录)+ 10x Flex 单细胞测序,约 30 万个细胞(Behind the data)。
  4. 划分:按差异表达基因数和高质量细胞数平衡地分成训练 150、验证 50、测试 100 个靶基因(Behind the data)。
  5. 参赛:队伍拿训练数据(可外加 Arc Virtual Cell Atlas 等公开数据)训练模型,对未见过的靶基因输出预测的单细胞表达(发布公告)。
  6. 打分:DES(Wilcoxon 检验、BH 校正 FDR ≤ 0.05 得到的差异表达基因集合,与真值的重叠比例)、PDS(pseudobulk delta 的 L1 距离排名,PDS_p = 1 − (r_p − 1)/N)、MAE(pseudobulk 全基因平均绝对误差);各自相对扰动均值基线归一化后取平均,每个指标设最低门槛;只按最终测试集排名(Behind the data 2025-10-01 更新版, 发布公告)。
  7. 追加 Generalist Prize:因 MAE 不再影响排名,对得分最高的 50 个最终提交用 7 个指标的平均名次另设大奖(wrap-up)。
  1. Pilot screen: a large CRISPRi pilot screen in H1 cells counts DE genes per perturbation (Behind the data).
  2. Pick targets: sample across strength bins and cluster responses in latent space with ContrastiveVI+, so the 300 targets cover different response modes (Behind the data).
  3. Generate data: dual-guide CRISPRi (dCas9-KRAB represses transcription) + 10x Flex single-cell sequencing, ~300,000 cells (Behind the data).
  4. Split: 150 train / 50 validation / 100 test targets, balanced by DE-gene count and number of high-quality cells (Behind the data).
  5. Compete: teams train on the training data (public data such as the Arc Virtual Cell Atlas allowed) and predict single-cell expression for unseen targets (launch page).
  6. Score: DES (overlap with the true DE-gene set, DE genes called by Wilcoxon test, BH FDR ≤ 0.05), PDS (rank of the L1 distance between pseudobulk deltas, PDS_p = 1 − (r_p − 1)/N) and MAE (pseudobulk error over all genes); each normalised against a perturbation-mean baseline and averaged, with a minimum threshold per metric; ranking on the final test set only (Behind the data, updated 1 Oct 2025; launch page).
  7. Generalist Prize added: since MAE no longer moved the ranking, the 50 top-scoring final entries were ranked by average rank over 7 metrics for a separate prize (wrap-up).

术语Terms

CRISPRi
用失活的 Cas9 带一个抑制结构域(KRAB)去压低某个基因的转录,不切 DNA。
Perturb-seq
一次对大量细胞做不同基因扰动,再用单细胞测序读出每个细胞的扰动和表达。
H1 hESC
一株人胚胎干细胞系,被充分表征(属于 ENCODE);不同于现有 Perturb-seq 数据中常见的永生化细胞系 K562、A375。
UMI
单细胞测序里给每个 RNA 分子加的唯一标签,用来计数分子;UMI 越多测得越深。
差异表达基因 DEG
扰动后表达显著上调或下调的基因。
pseudo-bulk
把同一扰动下所有细胞的表达求平均,当成一个“伪 bulk”样本;PDS 和 MAE 都在它上面计算。
CRISPRi
Uses a catalytically dead Cas9 carrying a repressor domain (KRAB) to turn down a gene's transcription without cutting DNA.
Perturb-seq
Perturbs many genes across a pool of cells at once, then reads each cell's perturbation and expression by single-cell sequencing.
H1 hESC
A human embryonic stem cell line, well characterised (part of ENCODE); unlike the immortalised lines K562 and A375 common in existing Perturb-seq data.
UMI
A unique tag attached to each RNA molecule in single-cell sequencing, used to count molecules; more UMIs means deeper sequencing.
DE gene (DEG)
A gene whose expression goes significantly up or down after a perturbation.
pseudo-bulk
The average expression of all cells under one perturbation, treated as a 'pseudo-bulk' sample; PDS and MAE are computed on it.

数据Data

约 300,000 个 H1 细胞、300 个 CRISPRi 靶基因;每个扰动约 1,000 个细胞,每个细胞 UMI 中位数 >50,000;63% 的细胞两个 guide 都正确检出,83% 的细胞敲低 >80%(Behind the data)。2025 数据集现可从 Arc Virtual Cell Atlas 下载(2026 公告)。

~300,000 H1 cells, 300 CRISPRi targets; ~1,000 cells per perturbation; median >50,000 UMIs per cell; 63% of cells with both guides detected, 83% with >80% knockdown (Behind the data). Now downloadable from the Arc Virtual Cell Atlas (2026 announcement).

主要结果Key results

5,000+ 人注册(114 国),1,200+ 队提交,300+ 队最终提交wrap-up
模型没有在所有指标上稳定胜过朴素基线;几乎所有模型 MAE 比基线差wrap-up
基于 L1 的 PDS 对尺度敏感:随预测幅度变大而上升;主办方称这“本身不算 bug”wrap-up
第 1 名 BM_xTVC(BioMap,10 万美元):scFoundation 改进模型 + 蛋白 embedding + 统计特征,融合 PDS+DES+MAE 损失,pseudo-bulk 训练wrap-up
第 2 名 XLearning Lab(5 万美元):全连接网络 + ESM-2 embedding,只用公开 Perturb-seq;第 3 名 Outlier(2.5 万美元):统计方法 TransPertwrap-up
Generalist Prize(10 万美元)Altos Labs:U-Net flow matching,约 700 万细胞预训练,7 个指标平均名次最高wrap-up
2026 届改为零样本:6 个细胞系(3 验证、3 测试),不发专门训练集,六指标综合分2026 公告
5,000+ registrants (114 countries), 1,200+ teams submitting, 300+ final submissionswrap-up
Models did not consistently beat naive baselines on all metrics; almost all were worse on MAEwrap-up
L1-based PDS is scale-sensitive: it rises with prediction magnitude; organisers call this "not a bug per se"wrap-up
1st BM_xTVC (BioMap, $100k): scFoundation-based model + protein embeddings + statistical features, fused PDS+DES+MAE loss, pseudo-bulkwrap-up
2nd XLearning Lab ($50k): fully connected net + ESM-2, public Perturb-seq only; 3rd Outlier ($25k): statistical TransPertwrap-up
Generalist Prize ($100k) Altos Labs: U-Net flow matching pretrained on ~7M cells, best 7-metric average rankwrap-up
2026 edition is zero-shot: 6 cell lines (3 validation, 3 test), no Challenge-specific training set, six-metric aggregate2026 announcement

结论Conclusions

Arc 认为:混合“深度学习 + 统计特征”胜过纯神经网络;损失设计与架构同样重要;蛋白 embedding 普遍有用;没有单一指标能代表模型质量,优化一个指标有时会牺牲其他指标(wrap-up)。

Arc concludes that hybrids of deep learning and statistical features beat purely neural models, loss design matters as much as architecture, protein embeddings help, and no single metric captures model quality; optimising one metric sometimes came at the cost of others (wrap-up).

局限Limitations

  • 主办方:窄的评分函数诱导优化指标而非生物学,2026 年因此改为六指标(2026 公告)。
  • 主办方:准确度、指标设计和生物学泛化仍需改进(2026 公告)。
  • 我们的理解:单一细胞类型、单基因敲低、只有转录组,没有组织或空间信息。
  • 我们的理解:前几名依赖 pseudo-bulk,评分主要奖励平均反应而非单细胞异质性。
  • 来源说明:未读到 Cell 全文;指标公式来自 Behind the data 2025-10-01 更新版(为与 STATE 预印本一致而更新),比赛开始时的公式可能不同。
  • Organisers: a narrow score invites metric optimisation over biology; hence six metrics in 2026 (2026 announcement).
  • Organisers: accuracy, metric design and biological generalisation still need work (2026 announcement).
  • Our reading: one cell type, single-gene knockdowns, transcriptome only; no tissue or spatial context.
  • Our reading: reliance on pseudo-bulk means the score mainly rewards the average response.
  • Source note: the full Cell text was not read; the metric formulas come from the 1 Oct 2025 update of Behind the data (updated to match the STATE preprint), so the formulas at launch may have differed.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

我们的理解:这是 model → revert 的前向模型评测:给定扰动预测细胞状态;revert 是它的反问题。对伪影注入课题最有用的是评测设计——按难度平衡划分、相对朴素基线归一化、用多个互补指标防止钻空子;这些可以直接搬到肾脏异常检测基准。对肾脏 revert 的直接价值有限,因为 H1 干细胞与肾脏细胞差别大,且没有组织尺度。

Our reading: this benchmarks the forward model for model → revert (perturbation → state); reversion is the inverse problem. Most useful for the artifact-injection topic is the evaluation design — difficulty-balanced splits, normalisation against a naive baseline, several complementary metrics to resist gaming — which transfers to a kidney anomaly benchmark. Direct value for kidney reversion is limited: H1 stem cells are far from kidney cells and there is no tissue scale.

Kidney Artificial Intelligence Discovery Challenge: From Nebulae to Nephrons

National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases. Kidney Artificial Intelligence Discovery Challenge: From Nebulae to Nephrons. NIH prize challenge hosted on HeroX. 2026.

https://www.herox.com/KidneyAI · 没有本地 PDF（见下方来源说明）No local PDF (see source note)

网页 / READMEweb page / README无本地 PDFno local PDF
HeroX 挑战页(2026-10-19 逐字抓取,2026-10-27 复核);HeroX 上挂在 NASA Tournament Lab 账号下;nih.gov 公告页返回 403
HeroX challenge page (verbatim capture 2026-10-19, re-checked 2026-10-27); listed on HeroX under the NASA Tournament Lab account; nih.gov announcement returned 403
NIDDK 的 10 万美元奖金挑战赛:只用 KPMP 公开数据,在肾活检全切片图像里发现以往未识别的形态模式或异常,并经专家人机协同复核 —— 目标是发现,不是分类。
A US$100,000 NIDDK prize challenge: using only open KPMP data, discover previously unrecognised patterns or anomalies in kidney-biopsy whole-slide images, backed by human–AI expert review — discovery, not classification.

问题Problem

美国约 3,550 万人患肾病,但疾病异质性、进展机制和治疗反应仍有大量空白。主办方认为假设驱动分析和基于分类的机器学习会漏掉稀有、细微、空间复杂或落在现有疾病类别之外的模式,想看异常检测、半监督学习、embedding 相似性检索和人机协同审阅能否像在天文学中那样在肾脏病理中找到新东西(HeroX Overview, Guidelines)。

About 35.5 million people in the US have kidney disease, yet heterogeneity, progression and treatment response remain poorly understood. The organisers argue that hypothesis-driven analysis and classification-based ML miss rare, subtle, spatially complex or out-of-category patterns, and ask whether anomaly detection, semi-supervised learning, embedding similarity search and human–AI review can repeat astronomy's success in kidney pathology (HeroX Overview, Guidelines).

方法（逐步）Method, step by step

  1. 数据:NIH 向所有参赛者提供一套统一的 KPMP 公开图像;只允许用 Kidney Tissue Atlas 的 open 数据(HeroX, Statutory Authority)。
  2. 方法:由参赛者自定,主办方举例异常检测、半监督学习、学到的 embedding 空间中的相似性检索(HeroX, Guidelines)。
  3. 输出:逐条描述每个发现,给出证据与科学理由(为何稀有、新颖或有意义)、技术方法、假设、验证程序、可靠性度量与局限(HeroX, Submission Requirements)。
  4. 可选:用图像异常结合临床参数或其他 KPMP 数据给患者分层或重新分类;给新特征指派分子机制留给未来挑战(HeroX, The Challenge)。
  5. 复现:提交物必须可运行,HeroX 会独立执行并复现所报告的发现(HeroX, Submission Requirements)。
  6. 评审:行政初筛 → Evaluation Panel 按 50/30/20 打分 → NIH Judging Panel 选出获奖者 → NIDDK 主任批准(HeroX, Judging)。
  1. Data: NIH supplies a common set of open KPMP images; only open Kidney Tissue Atlas data are allowed (HeroX, Statutory Authority).
  2. Method of choice, e.g. anomaly detection, semi-supervised learning, similarity search in learned embeddings (HeroX, Guidelines).
  3. Output: describe each discovery one by one, giving evidence and scientific rationale (why it is rare, novel or meaningful), technical methods, assumptions, validation procedures, reliability measures and limitations (HeroX, Submission Requirements).
  4. Optional: stratify or reclassify patients using image anomalies combined with clinical parameters or other KPMP data; assigning molecular mechanisms to new features is left to future challenges (HeroX, The Challenge).
  5. Reproducibility: submissions must be runnable; HeroX independently executes them and reproduces the reported findings (HeroX, Submission Requirements).
  6. Triage, then Evaluation Panel scoring (50/30/20), NIH Judging Panel selection, NIDDK Director approval (HeroX, Judging).

术语Terms

KPMP
Kidney Precision Medicine Project,NIDDK 支持的多中心项目,收集 CKD 和 AKI 患者的肾活检并做多尺度分析。
Kidney Tissue Atlas
KPMP 的数据资源,映射肾脏细胞类型、组织结构与疾病通路;分 open 与 controlled 两类数据。
CKD / AKI
慢性肾病 / 急性肾损伤,KPMP 收集活检的两类患者。
全切片图像 WSI
整张组织切片的高分辨率扫描图。
制片 / 扫描伪影
染色深浅、切片折叠、扫描仪差异等与疾病无关的图像变化。
KPMP
Kidney Precision Medicine Project, an NIDDK-supported multicentre project that collects kidney biopsies from CKD and AKI patients for multiscale analysis.
Kidney Tissue Atlas
KPMP's data resource mapping kidney cell types, tissue structures and disease pathways; its data are split into open and controlled.
CKD / AKI
Chronic kidney disease / acute kidney injury, the two patient groups whose biopsies KPMP collects.
WSI
Whole-slide image: a high-resolution scan of an entire tissue section.
Preparation / scanning artefacts
Image variation unrelated to disease, such as staining intensity, section folds and scanner differences.

数据Data

只能用 KPMP Kidney Tissue Atlas 中公开(open)的数据,不得用需数据使用协议的 controlled 数据;NIH 提供统一的合格图像集;公开数据已去标识化,不含个人身份信息(HeroX, Statutory Authority)。Overview 把范围写得更宽(组织图像、多组学、空间与临床信息),但评审第 1、2 项只针对肾活检全切片图像中的发现,第 3 项评可解释性与患者分层,允许结合临床参数或其他 KPMP 数据(HeroX, Overview, Judging Criteria)。

Only open data from the KPMP Kidney Tissue Atlas; no controlled data under a data-use agreement; NIH provides a common set of eligible images; public data are de-identified (HeroX, Statutory Authority). The Overview scopes images, multi-omics, spatial and clinical data, but criteria 1 and 2 score findings in whole-slide kidney biopsy images only, while criterion 3 scores interpretability and patient stratification and allows clinical parameters or other KPMP data (HeroX, Overview, Judging Criteria).

结论Conclusions

主办方期望短期内形成跨学科研究者网络、KPMP 数据中优先异常检测目标的目录、概念性分析流程和战略白皮书;长期希望发现新的疾病亚型、进展标志物和治疗反应特征(HeroX, The Challenge)。

Organisers expect a cross-disciplinary network, a catalogue of priority anomaly-detection targets in KPMP data, conceptual pipelines and a white paper in the near term, and new disease subtypes, progression markers and treatment-response signatures in the long term (HeroX, The Challenge).

局限Limitations

  • 主办方:提交要求仍在定稿,开放提交前才完整发布(HeroX, Submission Requirements)。
  • 主办方:给新特征指派分子机制不在本次范围(HeroX, The Challenge)。
  • 我们的理解:只能用 open 数据,不能用非公开数据作为提交依据;controlled 的个体层面组学与临床细节不可用。
  • 我们的理解:由专家打分,没有公开排行榜或固定 ground truth,结果难以和其他方法直接比较。
  • 我们的理解:非美国成员不能分奖金,参赛需美国合作者担任 Team Captain。
  • Organisers: submission requirements are still being finalised (HeroX).
  • Organisers: assigning molecular mechanisms is out of scope for now (HeroX).
  • Our reading: open data only, so non-public data cannot underpin a submission.
  • Our reading: expert-panel judging, no public leaderboard or fixed ground truth.
  • Our reading: non-US members get no prize money; a US Team Captain is needed.

对我们方向的意义Takeaway for our direction

我们的理解:这几乎是伪影注入课题的外部考场 —— 评审要求“区分真发现与染色、制片、扫描伪影”、“给置信度与失败模式”,正对应我们“跨模态一致性区分伪影与疾病”的假设;建议指标(top-k precision、seeded 发现的排名、专家审阅负担)可直接成为 KidneyAnomalyBench 的评测协议。方法可在其他数据上开发,但提交只能基于 open KPMP 数据,具体对“开发数据”的规定需等提交要求公布后核实。

Our reading: practically an external exam for the artifact-injection topic — the demand to separate true findings from staining, preparation and scanner artifacts and to report confidence and failure modes matches our hypothesis that cross-modal agreement separates artifacts from disease, and the suggested metrics (top-k precision, rank of seeded findings, expert review burden) can become KidneyAnomalyBench's protocol. Methods may be developed on other data, but submissions must rest on open KPMP data; check the rules on development data once requirements are published.
